* Exposure to virtual account and payment scheme infrastructure alongside traditional correspondent banking.

# Customer Solutions Specialist - North West (Manchester Area)

The Customer Solution Specialist is integral to delivering a superior and professional customer experience across DeterTech’s customer base. As the face of the organisation in advising on Customer Solutions, this role involves conducting detailed site surveys and post-incident assessments to ensure a comprehensive understanding of, and response to, customer needs.

Through robust customer engagement, technical evaluation, and collaboration with internal teams, the Customer Solution Specialist ensures that solutions are fit for purpose, customer satisfaction is maximised, and service quality is consistently maintained at a high standard.

## Key Responsibilities

**Site Surveys & Assessments**

* Conduct comprehensive on-site and off-site surveys for customers, assessing requirements and identifying appropriate solutions.
* Attend customer sites following break-ins or incidents to evaluate existing measures and recommend improvements.
* Ensure all surveys and assessments are completed to a consistently high standard.

**Quotations**

* Prepare and issue quotations following customer surveys, converting quotes into orders where possible.
* Raise SmartWater quotations, ensuring all documentation is accurate and complete.
* Ensure pricing, orders, and customer details are processed in line with agreed procedures and commercial guidelines.
* Support field-based sales colleagues and Operations by coordinating customer requirements.

**Customer Experience & Relationship Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers during the establishment of Customer Solutions, providing a professional, reassuring, and customer-focused presence.
* Build trust and rapport with customers through clear communication, reliability, and ownership of issues.
* Take accountability for the customer experience throughout the survey and assessment process.
* Ensure customer concerns are understood, managed, and appropriately escalated where required.

**Collaboration & Service Delivery**

* Collaborate closely with Sales, Customer Success, Engineers and ARC teams to ensure customer needs are clearly communicated and solutions are effectively delivered.
* Provide structured feedback to internal teams to support service improvement and solution design.
* Facilitate a seamless handover between survey, installation, and ongoing service.

**Documentation & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain accurate and timely records of site visits, findings, and customer interactions.
* Identify recurring issues or opportunities for improvement and share insights with relevant teams.
* Contribute to enhancing consistency, quality, and efficiency across survey and assessment processes.

## Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

* Experience in a customer-facing role, ideally in a field-based or on-site environment.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a clear commitment to excellent customer service.
* Comfortable working independently, managing time effectively, and travelling to customer locations.
* Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to assess situations objectively.
* Confident in representing DeterTech in customer environments with professionalism and credibility.
* Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across multiple internal teams.
* Familiarity with security systems or related technology is desirable but not essential.
* Proactive, reliable, and adaptable, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

**Key Measures of Success**

* **Customer Satisfaction:** Positive customer feedback following surveys, follow-ups, and assessments.
* **Quality & Consistency:** High standards maintained across all site surveys, quotes and customer interactions.
* **Issue Resolution:** Effective identification and communication of risks, issues, and improvement opportunities.
* **Operational Alignment:** Smooth collaboration and handover between field activity and internal teams.
* **Service Improvement:** Meaningful insights contributed to enhancing customer solutions and overall service delivery.

We specialize in delivering innovative solutions and exceptional services to meet the diverse needs of our clients. With a strong commitment to quality and customer satisfaction, we strive to exceed expectations and drive success in every project we undertake.

DHL Group is the logistics provider of the world with over 580,000 employees in more than 220 countries and territories. We are an organization that is not just moving goods around, we have a very clear purpose, and we are: Connecting People. Improving Lives.  We provide challenges and opportunities for personal and professional development, we recognize the difference you bring to our business and together we share the pride of building one of the largest world leaders in logistics and supply chain.

**Corporate Real Estate**(**CRE)** at DHL Group manages a global portfolio of more than 12,000 properties, covering over 30 million m2 worldwide. Join us and become part of a global CRE community shaping the logistics infrastructure of tomorrow.

**Job purpose:**

As a **CRE Sustainability Project Manager**, you will play a key role in helping DHL Group achieve its sustainability and decarbonization ambitions across one of the world's largest real estate portfolios.

As part of the ***Group’s Sustainability Road Map (published 2021),*** there are explicit sustainability commitments relating to real estate. Corporate Real Estate has a responsibility to provide a Building Decarbonization Framework (formerly CNB) that enables delivery of commitments. The Sustainable Buildings Project Manager, part of the global sustainability team, will project manage defined components of the Building Decarbonization Framework, conduct technology assessments and support implementation of technologies to reduce carbon emissions and improve energy efficiency – with a focus on PV and heating decarbonization.

**Your tasks:**

**Building Decarbonization Framework & Heating Decarbonization**

* Support the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of DHL's global Building Decarbonization Framework ensuring alignment with DHL Group and divisional requirements. The framework defines an internal global standard for decarbonization & energy efficiency that is adopted by all divisions
* Conduct market research and analysis of constantly evolving policies and legislation to ensure framework is relevant and compliant
* Assess new technologies and solutions that can improve energy efficiency and reduce carbon emissions across DHL facilities worldwide.
* Drive process improvements to enable quicker and more accurate evaluation of technologies for greater deployment across the Group
* Engage and upskill regional and country teams on the Building Decarbonization Framework, providing technical guidance and support in issue resolution
* Maintain user guides and documents published and available to all Divisions, including supporting and contributing to training sessions

**Solar PV and Heating Decarbonization assessments**

* Conduct technical and financial desktop assessments of solar PV and heating decarbonization opportunities across DHL properties.
* Work with divisional colleagues to create assigned business cases for solar and low carbon heating infrastructure BCA approvals, including submissions at a Corp Board level. Typically, 20-30 business cases are completed a year

* Support the implementation of solar PV and heating decarbonization projects, including updating the online tracker, overseeing progress and coordinating issue resolution

**Desktop CNB Assessment for Business case approvals**

* Act as the primary contact and coordinate the desktop CNB assessments needed as part of Business Case Approvals (BCAs). This includes both assigning new assessments to team members, tracking progress, ensuring they are completed to required quality standard and coordinating issue resolution

* Completing, with minimal supervision, a certain number of assigned desktop CNB assessments
* Identification of process improvements and upskilling country colleagues

* Strong interest in building decarbonization, solar PV, energy efficiency, and low-carbon technologies.
* Experience managing projects and working with multiple stakeholders in an international environment.
* Good understanding of sustainability principles, energy management, and climate-related challenges.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret technical and business data.
* Confident communicator with excellent written and verbal English skills.

# Technical Product Manager - Behavioural Analytics

London, England, United Kingdom

**Here's a summary of the role** 

Data is only powerful when everyone agrees what it means.  This is your chance to build a world class product behavioural data system and process from the ground up. 

We're rebuilding the internal product our teams use to measure product success and end-user value across all our 24+ products in four business units.    
   
You'll design the single source of truth: the metric definitions, the telemetry standards, the data contract engineering instruments against, the change governance processes and tooling, and the models that turn behaviour into portfolio insight. 

You'll educate and support the teams using this internal behavioural data product to set expectations and and plot a rational roadmap for the maturing of this product, helping our user to use the data honestly and wisely.    
   
Usage tells you what happened, not why, or whether it mattered. We want someone who sets quantitative behaviour against qualitative evidence and treats the disagreement as the interesting part. 

AWS/Snowflake is our spine; capture and BI are open decisions you'll help make. Your models feed the business reviews our executive team, CTO and investors use to run the portfolio, and engineering is committed to instrument against your contract. 

**Here's what your first twelve months should look like** 

* **First 90 days.** Learn the estate, meet the engineers who instrument it, and agree the measurement model for one product end to end — with a defensible adoption number and the qualitative read on what it means.

* **Three to six months.** Data contract published, instrumentation spec landed with engineering, first business unit building against it. Definitions, naming and versioned change control governed.

* **Six to twelve months.** Rolling out across the remaining business units through the BU-aligned analysts, portfolio reporting running on your numbers.

**Here's a breakdown of what you'll do (not all of it, just the important stuff)** 

* **Design the behavioural telemetry** — event and entity-state schemas at a grain that supports both portfolio roll-up and feature-level decisions — and write the instrumentation specification engineering builds against. Then assure what comes back: coverage, freshness, reconciliation.

* **Own the measurement standard** — canonical definitions, naming, field ownership, versioned change control — across every business unit.

* **Build the models** — SQL, BI and roll-up logic turning behaviour into insight on adoption, time-to-value and value realisation.

* **Triangulate.** Pair behavioural data with qualitative evidence from design research and VoC, segment by user role and account, and say so publicly when the two disagree.

* **Partner on the product, customer and user taxonomies**, set the technical standard for the BU-aligned analysts, and help shape the analytics stack as we revamp it.

**These are the essentials you'll need to get an interview** 

* **Direct experience building mixed-method behavioural insight systems** — you've built the layer where quantitative behaviour and qualitative evidence come together, not just consumed the output. You've worked alongside design or UX researchers, and can name a time the qualitative read changed what you measured.

* **Hands-on event and telemetry schema design** — Pendo, Amplitude, Segment, Mixpanel or equivalent. You designed the schema and wrote the spec, not used dashboards someone else built.

* **Designing and governing product data models and taxonomies** — canonical metrics and naming taken into a multi-product estate and made to stick, including acquired products.

* **Data governance practice**: schema and field ownership, versioned change control, standards adoption across teams you don't own.

* **Fluency in SQL and the BI / warehouse layer** — you build and validate roll-up logic yourself.

* **Behavioural segmentation judgement** — you know why a B2B account is a mix of people with different motivations, and why averaging them produces confident, wrong conclusions.

* **The credibility to influence without authority** — you can hold a standard with teams you don't line-manage.

**It would be great if you had these too, but we'll support you if you don't** 

* **Hands-on behavioural analytics and synthesis practice** — running the analysis yourself, not only building what enables it.

* **Privacy and lawful basis as live design constraints** — pseudonymisation, residency, re-identification controls.

* **GRC, governance or regulated-software domains.**

* **Salesforce, Jira Product Discovery, Pendo**, and consolidating fragmented tooling into one system of record.

* **Product value / ROI measurement** — connecting behaviour to commercial outcomes.

**How we'll assess this** 

We ask everyone to write SQL and design an event schema, and to talk us through a time qualitative evidence contradicted their numbers. No take-home longer than an hour. 

**Here's where this role goes next** 

We're building this function, not maintaining it. You set the standard the BU-aligned analysts land across the business — technical leadership from day one, without a management line. 

As the team grows around you — a data scientist, a behavioural researcher, an ML engineer — the routes are principal-level ownership of product behavioural data across Diligent, or leading the team that runs it. We'd rather be straight with you than promise a title we cannot yet name. The scope is real, and it is expanding.

**Have you always had an itch to scratch when it comes to helping dogs? We’re looking for someone who can provide our dogs with the highest level of care and enrichment, as they prepare for their forever home.

## What does this role do?

As Dog Welfare Assistant, you’ll:

* provide daily care to the dogs in the rehoming centre, working to Dogs Trust's code of practice and Health and Safety guidelines,
* educate potential new owners and the general public on the care and welfare of their dogs,
* deliver excellent customer service to all visitors to the centre.

## Could this be you?

The successful candidate will be an excellent communicator with the ability to show empathy to both people and animals. A strong team player, you'll have lots of energy and a positive upbeat attitude. A full, manual driving licence is also essential, as driving will be a part of the role.

## What does this team do?

Our rehoming centres house thousands of dogs each year until they can find a loving new home and the success of our centres wouldn’t be possible without our dedicated team of staff and volunteers; there is a real family-community within each of our centres. Dealing with thousands of visitors each month, our rehoming centres are the face of Dogs Trust, and we pride ourselves on our staff providing the very best in customer service.

We love dogs. That’s why we do whatever we can to make sure every four-legged friend gets the love they deserve. We’ll never put a healthy dog down, so our work is focused on helping dogs in need, supporting owners every step of the walk, and creating a better world for dogs in the future. It’s what we’ve been doing since 1891 and how we’ve grown to become the UK’s leading dog charity, helping 12,000 loyal friends find their forever homes every year.

## Description

**Job summary**

Autonomous Labs is building the next generation of AI-driven scientific laboratories, with the mission of automating the entire scientific discovery workflow - from experimental design and execution to analysis and iterative learning. Foundation models are a core component of this vision, enabling intelligent, adaptive, and autonomous scientific experimentation.

As a member of the technical team focused on foundation model performance, you will play a key role in understanding, evaluating, and improving the capabilities of frontier foundation models for embodied AI and autonomous scientific experimentation. This spans both autoregressive foundation models - the sequence-modelling backbone behind language, vision-language and action prediction - and world models and world action models that learn the dynamics of the laboratory well enough to simulate, plan and act on experiments before they are run. Your research will systematically investigate how training data, model development stages, and training strategies interact to determine model Internal Updated: August 2026 Job description - Internal capability. By uncovering these interactions, you will identify performance bottlenecks and develop novel approaches, such as new reward models, new learning curricula or data mixing strategies, that continuously improve foundation model performance.

This role offers a unique opportunity to conduct frontier research at the intersection of large-scale foundation models, data-centric AI, and embodied intelligence while solving real-world scientific problems. You will work closely with other AI researchers, software engineers, robotics engineers, and domain scientists to translate advances in autoregressive foundation models and world models into measurable improvements in autonomous laboratory performance.

The successful candidate will design and execute systematic experimental studies to understand how different data mixtures, data quality, model architectures, and training stages influence downstream capabilities and final performance in an end-to-end scientific workflow. You will identify performance bottlenecks and conduct research on improving foundation model performance through a deeper understanding of the interactions between data and models.

## Requirements

**Key responsibilities**

* Drive technical work on improving the performance of frontier foundation models - both autoregressive foundation models and world models - for autonomous scientific experimentation.
* Conduct research into the interactions between training data and foundation models to identify the key factors limiting model performance, and develop novel data-centric approaches for continuous improvement.
* Define and source the data needed to move model performance, working closely with domain experts across the laboratory to specify, collect, and curate high-value experimental datasets.
* Design and maintain scalable experimentation pipelines for model training, evaluation, benchmarking, and reproducible research.
* Analyse experimental results using rigorous scientific methodologies and translate insights into actionable improvements for model performance in a data-centric way.
* Collaborate closely with AI researchers, software engineers, robotics engineers, and scientific domain experts to ensure research findings translate into impactful real-world scientific capabilities.
* Contribute novel research ideas and publish high-quality research where appropriate, while maintaining a strong focus on practical deployment.
* Communicate experimental findings and technical insights clearly across interdisciplinary teams to help shape the future direction of the AutoLab AI platform.

**Essential knowledge, skills, and experience**

* MSc, PhD, or equivalent industry experience in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related discipline.
* Hands-on experience with frontier foundation models, including autoregressive foundation models such as Large Language Models (LLMs), Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, as well as embodied AI models and world models.
* Experience with continuous pre-training, post-training, supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and other foundation model optimisation techniques.
* Hands-on experience building end-to-end machine learning pipelines, including data curation, data mixing, model training, evaluation, performance analysis, and iterative model improvement.
* Experience working within interdisciplinary teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex experimental findings clearly across disciplines.
* An impact-driven mindset with a passion for continuously improving model performance for real world deployment.

Desirable knowledge, skills, and experience

In rough order of desirability.

* Research experience in embodied AI and robotics.
* Research or engineering experience with world models, model-based reinforcement learning, or learned simulators.

Overview  
  

**ENERPAC – Who we are?**

Enerpac Tool Group Corp. is a premier industrial tools, services, technology and solutions provider serving a broad and diverse set of customers in more than 100 countries. For further information on Enerpac Tool Group and its businesses, visit the Company's website at **https://www.enerpactoolgroup.com/**.

**Summary – basic function of the role**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Quality Engineer to join our team in Cramlington on a permanent basis, working onsite five days per week.

This is a senior, hands-on position offering the opportunity to take broad ownership of quality activities across the site and play a key role in shaping quality standards, manufacturing capability and continuous improvement. The Senior Quality Engineer will support the development, implementation and ongoing effectiveness of Enerpac UK’s Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with applicable site, regional and global quality standards.

The successful candidate will bring strong manufacturing quality experience, including practical knowledge of metallic materials and manufactured components. Working closely with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain and other business functions, they will lead quality improvement initiatives, resolve complex quality issues and help strengthen a proactive culture of quality throughout the organisation.

**Job Duties and Responsibilities**

* Support the development and continuous improvement of the QMS, ensuring ongoing compliance with ISO 9001 requirements and applicable company quality policies, procedures and standards.
* Lead and support internal, supplier and customer audit activities, including audit planning, preparation, delivery, reporting and the timely closure of resulting corrective actions.
* Coordinate document control, management reviews and other core QMS activities to maintain effective and consistent quality standards across the site.
* Establish, monitor, analyse and report key quality metrics, including customer complaints, supplier performance, cost of poor quality, scrap and rework, audit findings, non-conformance closure times and overall QMS effectiveness.
* Lead the investigation and resolution of internal, supplier and customer quality issues, using structured root-cause analysis and corrective-action methodologies.
* Ensure quality issues and non-conformances are accurately recorded and managed within the Qualityze system, maintaining clear communication with internal and external stakeholders throughout the resolution process.
* Apply knowledge of metallic materials and manufactured components when investigating quality concerns, reviewing specifications and assessing product conformity.
* Review and interpret engineering drawings, material specifications, dimensional tolerances, inspection requirements and material certification or traceability documentation.
* Work closely with Engineering, Operations and Supply Chain to address material-related quality issues, including those connected with machining, heat treatment, surface finish, coatings and other relevant manufacturing processes.
* Maintain a hands-on approach to quality assurance, supporting CMM programming, dimensional inspection and component measurement during peak periods, complex projects or when additional technical support is required.
* Support operations, logistics and supply chain activities by identifying quality risks and implementing practical, sustainable improvements.
* Use non-conformance, scrap, rework and customer complaint data to identify trends and lead continuous improvement initiatives across manufacturing and associated operational processes.
* Support the strategy to increase in-house manufacturing capability by assessing quality requirements, determining product suitability for insourcing and coordinating associated trials, validation and implementation activities.
* Partner with suppliers to improve component and material quality, address recurring issues and strengthen supplier quality performance.
* Coach, influence and train employees across different functions to build quality capability and strengthen a culture of continuous improvement.
* Manage and support the development of the Apprentice Quality Inspector, including objective setting, workload coordination, technical guidance and ongoing coaching.
* Act as a senior quality representative for the Cramlington site, providing guidance on complex quality matters and constructively challenging decisions where quality, compliance or customer requirements may be at risk.
* Promote safety awareness and continuous improvement, identifying opportunities to increase efficiency and deliver results while maintaining quality and regulatory compliance.
* Represent the company professionally and act as a role model for quality, integrity and health and safety excellence.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Strong quality engineering experience within a manufacturing, engineering or similarly regulated technical environment.
* Practical experience working with metallic materials and manufactured components, with an understanding of material specifications, properties, certification and traceability requirements.
* Sound understanding of manufacturing processes involving metals, ideally including CNC machining, assembly, hydraulics, heat treatment, surface finishing or industrial equipment.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, geometric and dimensional tolerances, material specifications and inspection requirements.
* Experience with component inspection and measurement techniques. Exposure to CMM programming or operation would be advantageous.
* Strong knowledge of ISO 9001 requirements and the practical application of Quality Management Systems.
* Knowledge and practical application of quality tools and methodologies such as APQP, PPAP, MSA, FMEA, Control Plans, SPC, 8D, root-cause analysis and corrective action.
* Demonstrated ability to investigate complex quality issues, analyse data and implement effective, sustainable solutions.
* Experience using ERP/MRP and electronic quality management systems. Knowledge of Qualityze would be advantageous.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Power BI or other data analysis and reporting tools would be beneficial.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence to engage, influence and constructively challenge stakeholders at all organisational levels.
* Strong coaching, facilitation, training and presentation capabilities.
* A positive, persuasive and motivating approach, with the ability to lead through technical expertise and influence.
* Assertive yet diplomatic, with a strong understanding of operational, customer and commercial priorities.
* Proven ability to work cross-functionally and within global, multicultural teams.
* Self-motivated, well organised and capable of managing multiple priorities within demanding deadlines.

 

**Education and Experience**

* A degree, HNC/HND or equivalent qualification in Quality, Manufacturing, Mechanical, Materials Engineering or a related technical discipline would be advantageous. Equivalent relevant industry experience will also be considered.
* A minimum of five years’ quality engineering experience within a manufacturing or engineering environment.
* Demonstrable experience implementing, maintaining and improving Quality Management Systems.
* Extensive working knowledge of ISO 9001.
* ISO 9001 Lead Auditor certification or equivalent auditing qualification and experience.
* Proven experience developing, training, coaching or mentoring others within a quality-driven environment.
* Previous experience operating at Senior Quality Engineer, Lead Quality Engineer or an equivalent level would be advantageous. Applications are also welcomed from experienced Quality Engineers who can demonstrate the capability and ambition to step into a broader, more influential position.

 

**Work Benefits**

* Competitive salary, performance incentives and benefits package.
* Community outreach programmes embedded within the company’s culture.

**About Flash Pack:**

When was the last time you made a new friend? The quality of your relationships is the single most important factor for your mental health. Travel has a unique ability to fast-forward the friendship-making process, which is why we’re on a mission to create one million meaningful friendships using the power of travel and technology as a platform for human connection.

You can find out more about our culture and life at Flash Pack here.

**What you’ll find here:**

1. **A culture built around high performance, high conviction and humility**. We value teamwork over grandiosity, great questions over corporate euphemisms, and autonomy over conformity.
2. **An ambitious, high-growth, mid-stage start-up** with proven product-market fit across 15+ global markets, well-capitalised and backed by founders, investors and entrepreneurs who have built multi-billion-dollar companies.
3. **A highly collaborative team** on a mission to create one million meaningful friendships across the globe through travel.

**The Role:**

In adventure travel, safety isn't the opposite of bold product; it's the licence to build it. The operators who lead this space aren't the ones running the tamest trips; they're the ones whose risk management is good enough to let them say yes with confidence. That's the standard we're hiring for: not "minimise risk," but understand and manage risk well enough to take more of it, deliberately.

This is a full-time, standalone **Head of Health & Safety** role, dedicated entirely to the safety discipline: the risk framework, supplier assurance, incident learning loop and crisis response that let Flash Pack's product and marketing teams design bolder trips with confidence, not less oversight.

You'll own Flash Pack's safety standard end to end: not a compliance function that defaults to "no" and gets routed around, but a lean, high-leverage approach that sets the boundaries clearly enough that most decisions never need to escalate, and steps in fast, personally, when they do.

In line with our salary framework, **the salary for this role is £80,000- £86,000**, depending on experience. **You must be based in London**, or close commutable distance, and be able to undertake some destination travel for supplier audits and incident response.

**Travel & Working Pattern:**

This role is not desk-only: expect some travel to destinations for supplier audits, incident follow-up, and trip-leader training, alongside London-based/remote-flexible working for the rest of the time.

This is also **an on-call role**. When a serious incident happens, you need to be reachable and able to respond immediately, any time of day, any day of the year, **including evenings, weekends and public holidays**. Standard working hours don't apply when a customer or Pack Leader is in danger.

**Where you will spend your time:**

1. **Setting the boundaries**: decide how much risk Flash Pack is willing to take, and where, so the rest of the business can move fast and design boldly within limits you've set, instead of asking your permission case by case.
2. **Building safety in, not bolting it on:** make sure safety is part of how new trips and experiences get designed from the start, so it speeds good ideas up rather than slowing them down.
3. **Owning who we work with in the field:** set and hold the safety bar for every supplier and ground partner Flash Pack relies on, and decide who's good enough to work with us; in adventure travel, this is where most of the real risk sits.
4. **Leading when it matters most:** be the person who makes the call on a live incident, coordinate everyone involved until it's resolved, and make sure the company is measurably better prepared after every incident and near-miss than it was before.
5. **Getting the field ready:** make sure everyone delivering our trips has the training, judgement and support to handle a crisis without waiting for head office, and that Flash Pack can respond, day or night.
6. **Working cross-functionally:** act as the connective layer across product, ops, CX and other teams, facilitating shared decisions on risk and bringing the right people together, rather than trying to hold all of it yourself.
7. **Using data and AI well:** use data to see risk before it becomes a problem, not just to report on it afterwards, and make sure AI is used responsibly anywhere it touches customer safety, with a human always accountable for the final call.
8. **Making safety a reason to trust us:** shape how Flash Pack talks about safety so it reads as confidence, not fine print, and represent our safety standards credibly to partners, insurers and, where needed, regulators.
9. **Owning the risk conversation at the top:** give the CEO and board a clear, credible view of Flash Pack's risk position whenever they need one.

**What we’d love to see from you:**

1. **Real adventure-travel or high-risk-activity safety experience:** you've owned safety and risk in group travel, expedition, outdoor-activity or a comparably regulated, high-consequence consumer environment, and you can talk through incidents you've actually handled, not just policies you've written.
2. **Judgement under pressure:** you can make a fast, defensible call on a live incident without waiting for sign-off, and you know the difference between a decision that needs to escalate and one that doesn't.
3. **A builder's mindset:** you've matured a safety function, risk framework or supplier-assurance process before, and you enjoy shaping systems and processes, not just maintaining them.
4. **Commercial fluency:** you can hold the tension between safety and product ambition without collapsing into either extreme: you look for the "yes, if," not the reflexive "no," and you understand that a bad safety function destroys revenue just as surely as a bad incident does.
5. **Comfort with data and AI as tools, not threats:** you're not intimidated by using data and AI-assisted tools to extend what a small team can see and do, and you're equally clear-eyed about where AI output needs a human safety check before it reaches a customer.
6. **A genuine people-leader and facilitator:** you can manage and develop the one direct report you'll have from day one, and you're just as effective leading and influencing people who don't report to you at all, across product, ops and CX.
7. **Executive presence:** you can brief the CEO and board on serious incidents and risk appetite clearly and without drama, and represent Flash Pack credibly to insurers, partners and, where needed, regulators or media.
8. **Nice-to-have:** familiarity with recognised risk-management and travel-safety standards

We’re after the right person and if you don’t quite hit all the criteria, we’d still encourage you to apply. We’d love to chat and see if you could be a great fit for Flash Pack.

Our interviews take place on Google Meet and usually consist of the following stages:

* Introductory chat with our talent team to see if there is a match (30-45 mins)
* An interview with the hiring manager to hear more about your background and experience and to give you a deep dive into the role (60 mins)
* A case study and presentation with the hiring manager and a key stakeholder to see how you’d solve a problem (60 mins)
* Meet with one of our founders for any final questions you or we have (45-60 mins)

We are seeking a highly experienced and innovation-driven Software Consulting Engineer to lead the architecture, design, and development of advanced software platforms and configuration tools for Transmission & Distribution (T&D) systems.

Define the architecture and evolution of scalable, modular, and secure software platforms for T&D configuration systems, including tools for device configuration, substation engineering, and grid automation workflows.
Define technical strategy and oversee the design cloud-native platforms using modern frameworks (.NET, Java, Python, TypeScript) that support desktop, edge, and cloud deployments, with emphasis on performance, resilience, and maintainability.
Drive the integration IEC 61850 engineering workflows (SCL-based ICD, SCD, SSD) into intuitive, automated tooling ecosystems aligned with modern UI/UX, API design, and utility integration requirements.

Collaborate with cybersecurity, systems, and hardware architects to deliver secure, compliant solutions for critical infrastructure, incorporating secure development lifecycle (SDLC) and DevSecOps practices.
Drive reuse of software components across product lines, fostering platform consistency, reducing duplication, and accelerating development.
Oversee development and lifecycle management of configuration and commissioning tools for protection and control devices, ensuring seamless integration with SCADA/DMS/EMS and other utility systems.
Conduct software and architecture reviews, ensure compliance with industry standards (IEC 61850, IEC 61968/70, CIM, IEC 62351), and manage the end-to-end software development lifecycle from requirements to deployment and support.
Partner with architects, systems engineers, and utility customers to define and deliver customer-centric, technically robust solutions that improve reliability, visibility, and flexibility of grid systems.

## Company Description

Genomics England is a global leader in enabling genomic medicine and research, focused on creating a world where everyone benefits from genomic healthcare. Building on the 100,000 Genomes Project, we support the NHS’s world-first national whole genome sequencing service and run the growing National Genomic Research Library, alongside delivering numerous major genomics initiatives. By connecting research and clinical care at national scale, we enable immediate healthcare benefits and advances for the future.

Our mission is to provide the evidence and digital systems so that by 2035 genomics could play a role in up to half of all healthcare interactions, whilst securing the UK’s position as the best place to discover, prove and benefit from genomic innovations.

We are accelerating our impact and working with patients, doctors, scientists, government and industry to improve genomic testing, and help researchers access the health data and technology they need to make new medical discoveries and create more effective, targeted medicines for everybody.

Behind the Healthcare and Research outcomes, Genomics England delivers through designing, developing and operating complex healthcare software systems.

We're on the cusp of big changes with the real prospect of genomics becoming the fabric of everyday healthcare through the lifetime – from birth to old age.

## Job Description

We are seeking a Genomic Data Scientist to join our Bioinformatics Consulting team to work on a range of genome analysis and interpretation projects with an emphasis in rare or complex disease, in collaboration with and on behalf of our external researchers and industrial partners.

In this role, you will work as part of multidisciplinary teams to develop and execute cutting edge projects that leverage Genomics England datasets to address research goals such as drug target identification, biomarker discovery, diagnostic discovery, and patient stratification.

You will contribute to the scoping, implementation, and application of state-of-the-art approaches for analysis of genomic and other omics modalities, in both leading and supporting capacity. As an expert user of our datasets and research environment, you will develop and fine-tune tools and pipelines to perform custom computational analyses, generate new data and contribute to high quality reports and documentation.

**Everyday responsibilities include:**

* Preparing data for downstream analysis, e.g. through quality control, functional annotation, aggregation, harmonisation across different datasets.
* Planning and supporting analyses to meet project objectives with internal teams and external stakeholders. Providing support to internal teams and collaborators and being the point of reference for genomic datasets and analytical approaches.
* Performing custom computational analyses on whole genome sequencing and other omics data, such as GWAS, aggregate variant testing, meta-analysis, differential abundance, fine-mapping and MR.
* Researching the scientific literature, identifying new approaches to processing and analysis of genomics and multi-omics data, benchmarking and improving tools.
* Contributing to the publication and dissemination of findings via scientific papers, white papers and conference presentations.

**Skills and experience for success:**

* Strong programming skills (R, Python) and solid background of statistical genetics.
* Demonstrable experience using whole genome sequencing data in the context of human genetics.
* Strong background in human disease genetics, preferably in rare or complex disease, demonstrated by publication record or industry track record.
* Demonstrable experience in working with long read sequencing data (preferred) or other omics modalities.
* Proven track record in one or more areas of human germline DNA analysis such as genetic association testing, population genetics, pharmacogenomics, rare disease genomics, structural variation analysis, working with complex genomic regions such as HLA/KIR/PGx.
* Experience with working in the cloud, building containers, and running pipelines using workflow languages (ideally Nextflow).
* Proven ability to communicate with stakeholders from diverse backgrounds (e.g. management, IT, R&D, biology, bioinformatics) and keep track of customer relationships, and a clear understanding of clinical and phenotypic data management and the sensitivities surrounding patient cohort data.
* Excellent interpersonal skills, attention to detail, self-motivation, collaborative and delivery mindset

A PhD involving one of the following: Statistical or Computational Genetics, Biostatistics, Population Genetics or equivalent quantitative discipline.

* Understanding of the importance of various forms of research activities and outputs in the UK genomics ecosystem

General Summary:

This role reports to the R&D Team Leader or their designee and is based in Banbury, UK. The role supports the delivery and contribution of departmental and organisational objectives. Responsible for supporting day‐to‐day operations within their area of responsibility, working collaboratively with colleagues and stakeholders to ensure high standards of service, compliance, and performance. Adherence to organisational policies and procedures, effective communication with line management, and a commitment to continuous improvement and inclusive ways of working is essential.

As part of the HPE Networking sales team, you will drive the technical sales activities for a selected group of Tier 2 service provider customers in the UK. You will act as a trusted technical adviser, translate customer priorities into solution architectures and help customers modernise their networks and operations.

**The opportunity:** Lead the technical sales engagement for a selected set of Tier 2 service provider customers, bringing together HPE Networking capabilities across routing, switching, security, automation, assurance and cloud operations.

Successful Systems Engineers combine deep networking expertise with hands-on technical credibility, commercial awareness and the ability to communicate clearly with varied audiences. You will use the breadth of the HPE portfolio, together with partner and ecosystem capabilities, to shape solutions that address customer requirements and deliver measurable business outcomes.

The ideal candidate has strong experience with service provider networks, especially IP routing, MPLS and segment routing, and a working understanding of adjacent domains such as data centre networking, security, network automation, virtualisation and cloud. You will build trusted, long-term relationships with technical decision-makers by understanding each customer’s strategy, architecture, operational model, organisation and buying process.

AI-native operations, assurance, automation and sustainability are increasingly important in customer strategies and tenders. * Own and drive the technical sales strategy and technical account plan for assigned customers, aligned with the account team and the customer’s business priorities.

* Build, develop and maintain trusted relationships with technical decision-makers, architects, operations teams, procurement stakeholders and the partner community.
* Lead technical responses to RFI, RFP and RFQ processes, including solution compliance, high-level designs, bills of materials, risk identification and technical validation.
* Coordinate specialists and internal resources across HPE to deliver a consistent customer experience and the strongest possible technical outcome.
* Capture new customer requirements, market trends and competitive insight, and provide structured feedback to product management and business units.
* Maintain accurate opportunity and activity information, identify technical risks early and support the account team through the full sales cycle.
* Continuously develop your technical, industry and competitive knowledge, and share expertise with colleagues and customers.

**Preferred qualifications and experience:**

* Typically 6+ years of relevant experience with service provider networks in a technical pre-sales, Sales/Systems Engineering, consulting or network architecture role. Equivalent depth of experience is equally valued.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant industry certifications, for example JNCIP/JNCIE, CCNP/CCIE, CISSP or HPE technical certifications, are beneficial but not mandatory.
* Expert-level understanding of IP routing technologies and protocols. Strong knowledge of MPLS and segment routing is essential.
* Demonstrable hands-on capability in service provider routing, with useful experience in one or more adjacent areas: data centre switching, network security, automation, network virtualisation, cloud networking or observability and assurance.
* Experience designing resilient, scalable and operationally supportable network solutions, and the ability to explain architecture choices and trade-offs clearly.
* Knowledge of network automation and programmability using technologies such as Python, Ansible, NETCONF, YANG, REST APIs, JSON and OpenConfig is desirable.
* Understanding of service provider security, DDoS protection, zero-trust principles or secure managed services is an advantage.

* Knowledge of HPE Networking products and solutions is desirable. Strong experience with relevant competitive platforms is also valued.
* Ability to build and deliver demonstrations or proofs of concept that showcase routing, switching, assurance and automation capabilities.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation and whiteboarding skills, with the ability to communicate complex topics to audiences ranging from network engineers to senior technical and business leaders.
* Self-motivated and collaborative, able to work independently, prioritise effectively, keep multiple activities moving and perform well in a fast-paced environment.

## Stock Control Analyst - Inverness

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and highly motivated individual to join our Finance team based in Inverness as a Stock Control Analyst. Reporting to the Stock Controller, this role will play a key part in supporting and driving stock management processes across the business.

The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy of stock-related financial transactions, supporting month-end stock processes, and helping to develop and centralise stock control procedures for both wet stock (fuel) and dry stock operations. Working closely with Finance, Operations, Site Managers and site teams, the role will focus on improving consistency, compliance and efficiency across the Highland Fuels network.

The position will involve building strong working relationships across multiple sites and may require travel to depots and filling stations to support stock control activities, process improvements and operational projects.

**Main Purpose of the Role**

* Ensure accuracy in stock invoicing, reconciliation and financial processing.
* Support the development and centralisation of stock control processes across wet stock and dry stock operations.
* Work collaboratively with Site Managers and operational teams to improve stock accuracy, reporting and compliance.
* Support the timely and accurate completion of month-end stock processes.
* Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency and control across the business.
* Provide operational support and cover across the stock control function.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Invoice Matching & Financial Accuracy**

* Match bulk fuel receipts in CODAS to automated and manual supplier invoices.
* Process invoices using the correct nominal codes within Opera.
* Review confirmation logs and investigate discrepancies.
* Ensure stock-related invoices are processed accurately and in a timely manner.
* Support accurate financial reporting through robust stock controls.

**2. Fuel Bunkering Reconciliation**

* Reconcile weekly bunkering figures across filling station locations.
* Cross-check activity against Key Fuels and UK Fuels reports.
* Investigate and resolve discrepancies promptly.
* Maintain complete and auditable reconciliation records.

**3. Month-End Stock Processes**

* Complete stock-related month-end activities by working day four, including:
  + Finalising miscellaneous stocks
  + Duty reclaim calculations
  + HVO reporting
  + OAMPS stock valuation
  + Spot buy reconciliations
* Ensure all received fuel is invoiced prior to month-end closure.
* Support the production of accurate stock reports and valuations.

**4. Stock Process Development & Business Improvement**

* Support the development and implementation of standardised stock control procedures across the business.
* Assist in centralising stock management processes for both wet stock and dry stock operations.
* Review existing processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy and control.
* Work with operational teams to embed best practice stock management procedures.
* Produce reports, analysis and recommendations to support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Participate in stock-related projects and business improvement activities.

**5. Site Collaboration & Operational Support**

* Build effective working relationships with Site Managers and site teams.
* Conduct site visits to support stock investigations, process reviews and training activities.
* Assist sites in resolving stock-related issues and implementing agreed procedures.
* Promote consistency of stock management practices across all locations.

**6. Compliance & Governance**

* Ensure compliance with company financial controls, policies and procedures.
* Review automated inputs, reports and logs for accuracy and completeness.
* Maintain accurate and audit-ready stock records.
* Support internal and external audit requirements where required.

**7. Team Support & Cover**

* Provide cover for colleagues during periods of absence.
* Assist the Stock Controller and Finance Director with stock-related projects and reporting requirements.
* Adapt to changing business priorities and operational needs.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Previous experience in stock control, inventory management or stock accounting.
* Strong understanding of stock reconciliation processes.
* Excellent attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent organisational and time management skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to identify opportunities for process improvement and support change.

**Desirable**

* Experience within the fuel, retail or distribution sectors.
* Experience using CODAS and Opera systems.
* Familiarity with Key Fuels and UK Fuels platforms.
* Experience of working across multiple sites or locations.
* Experience supporting operational improvement projects.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary
* Company pension scheme and benefits
* Ongoing training and development opportunities
* Opportunity to contribute to business improvement initiatives
* Supportive and growing business environment

**Additional Information**

* Office-based role in Inverness.
* Regular travel to depots and filling stations may be required.
* Full driving licence desirable.
* Some flexibility may be required during month-end periods.

Reporting to the I&PS Engineering Team Leader, the post holder will be responsible for providing specialist engineering, safety and technical support to the asset teams in matters relating to all manners of field instrumentation and protective systems.

* Adhere to and promote INEOS 20 Principles and 7 Life Saving Rules to colleagues and external vendors.

* Responsible for maintaining the asset and protective systems integrity.
* Address day to day discipline operations support issues related to SIS, F&G, bad actors etc, through daily Ops meeting and asset team.
* Management of local instrument and SIS spares, and health care provision.
* Provide input to remaining life determination and extension, obsolescence studies and asset life strategies.
* Day to day management and continuous improvement of the SIS LoPs across the area / asset by reviewing associated KPI data e.g. overrides/bypasses, overdue proof testing, SIS demands, failure data, etc and coordinating any necessary changes due to actual field performance.
* Implement/manage minor I&PS modifications, and provide technical review, through the management of change system.
* SIS Lifecycle management to IEC 61508/61511 — ensure all roles/responsibilities are covered and ensure that requirements are being met to maintain SIS integrity.
* Provide input and support to Projects and TARs.
* Development and implementation of improvement proposals in the area of asset and maintenance management.
* Define technical specifications for requisitions in the context of equipment modifications and replacements.
* Providing technical support in trouble shooting and emergency situations.
* As a specialist, provide training and education to the Technician and Operator population.
* Develop and maintain the required functional safety documentation as defined in BS EN 61511.
* Fault finding and optimisation of compressor control systems.
* Commissioning, modification and fault analysis of Honeywell Safety Manager or Triconex V11 Safety Systems.
* Risk assessment and asset management relating to the safe operation of equipment.
* Carry out SIF reliability studies and develop calculations using appropriate software (e.g. TRAC, exSILentia, ISOGRAPH).

* At least 5 years of technical experience in a technical role (discipline engineering, maintenance management) in Oil and Gas Upstream, Midstream or Downstream environments.

* Participation in HAZOP and LOPA workshops and review of output.
* Knowledge of the functional safety lifecycle.

Our client is a leading global investment management company headquartered in London. It manages over $228 billion in assets and serves institutional investors, pension funds, wealth managers, and other sophisticated clients worldwide. The firm specializes in quantitative investing, alternative investments, systematic trading strategies, and technology-driven asset management. Data science, machine learning, and AI are core components of its investment and research processes.

As part of our collaboration we will focus on two foundational capabilities required to enable safe and scalable AI adoption across the enterprise: Agentic Security and AI-Ready Data Foundations.

### What project we have for you

We build the data foundations and evaluation frameworks that make AI useful, reliable and safe inside regulated financial firms. The value of an AI agent depends not only on the models behind it, but also on the quality of the structured and unstructured data it consumes and the accuracy, relevance and traceability of the outputs it produces. Your job is to measure that quality, identify where it breaks down and turn the findings into practical improvements.

This is an \***engineering**\* role, not an analytical one. You will build the agentic workflows that reason over the firm’s research content, and the ingestion, evaluation and guardrail tooling that makes their output trustworthy enough for investment professionals to act on. None of this tooling exists today — you would be building it from scratch.

### What you will do

* \***Build agentic workflows**\* that reason over research reports, transcripts, filings and news, and present portfolio managers with a clear view of what was found, what is missing, and how confident the system is in each answer.
* \***Engineer automated quality checks on unstructured source content**\* before ingestion — empty or blank content, truncation, extraction fidelity, coverage gaps across expected document sets.
* \***Build vendor delivery validation**\*: detect and quantify parsing and format defects in incoming feeds, feed them back to vendors and the data sourcing team, and fix extraction where it sits with us.
* \***Build evaluation harnesses, benchmarks and guardrails**\* for agent output — groundedness, factual accuracy, relevance, and citation/provenance, so any claim can be traced back to a specific file and snippet.
* \***Ship monitoring and dashboards**\* surfacing data-quality findings, confidence levels and coverage gaps to both engineering and PM audiences.
* Work directly with the platform engineering team, data sourcing, and portfolio managers to turn business expectations into measurable, automated quality standards.

### What you need for this

* Proven experience **building production agentic and LLM systems** — multi-agent or orchestrated workflows that reason across heterogeneous sources (PDFs, audio transcripts, file shares, databases) and surface confidence, gaps and provenance back to end users.
* Hands-on experience **engineering document ingestion and extraction pipelines**: parsing, chunking and the automated quality controls around them — detecting empty or truncated content, vendor feeds delivering the wrong section of a document, duplication, encoding and OCR defects.
* Experience **building evaluation and guardrail infrastructure** for AI systems: groundedness scoring, citation and provenance (file name plus the exact snippet retrieved), eval harnesses, regression suites and LLM observability.
* **Strong production Python engineering** — services and pipelines that run unattended, with testing, CI and code standards. This is not a notebook-and-analysis role.
* Able to work from a deliberately vague brief, shape the problem directly with business stakeholders, and explain technical results to non-technical audiences.

**Nice to have**

* Experience tuning retrieval quality — chunking strategy, embedding choice, retrieval evaluation.
* Structured and time-series data-quality experience (coverage gaps, nulls in critical columns).
* ETL pipelines and fluency in SQL.
* Previous experience working with investment professionals in a fast-paced environment.
* Working knowledge of Snowflake, Linux/UNIX, Git, Jira.

### What it’s like to work at Intellias

At Intellias, where technology takes center stage, people always come before processes. By creating a comfortable atmosphere in our team, we empower individuals to unlock their true potential and achieve extraordinary results. That’s why we offer a range of benefits that support your well-being and charge your professional growth.

# Staff FPGA Engineer

Oxford, England, United Kingdom

**About IonQ:**

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.  
  
Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

**What to expect:**

We are looking for a Staff FPGA Engineer to join our FPGA Team at IonQ. In this role, you will be responsible for designing and developing FPGA features, contributing to the team’s mission of delivering best in class control systems. You’ll play an important part in shaping hardware that supports our work in building the world’s most advanced quantum systems.

**What you’ll be responsible for:**

In this position, you will work on designing, developing and testing RTL modules, supporting the effective delivery of real-time control logic for quantum control systems. You’ll have the opportunity to own, architect, and develop critical control functions, contributing directly to the success of operating a quantum computer.

* Work independently to design and implement FPGA based signal processing and control functions and develop functional block specifications based on system level requirements
* Perform logic design using Vivado (Verilog or VHDL, IP Catalog, and Block Design as well as perform logic simulation/verification using simulation/verification software
* Simulate signal processing and control algorithms in software
* Implement and test firmware for high speed waveform generation and digital control loops. Write test procedures, perform unit and system level testing and debug, document test results

**Requirements**

To be successful, you will need strong FPGA design and verification experience and experience working on complex systems. You will have experience in development, verification, and debugging of FPGA-based systems, with a strong focus on signal processing and high-performance embedded solutions. We’re looking for someone who can work cross-functionally to gather requirements, architect, design, and contribute effectively within a fast-moving, highly technical team.

Janus Henderson is undertaking a firm-wide AI Transformation program to embed AI capabilities across every business function. The AI Business Partner is a new role at the heart of this effort — you will be embedded directly within a business unit, working side-by-side with teams to identify high-value AI opportunities, build practical solutions, and drive measurable adoption. Over time, you will rotate across departments, carrying proven patterns and solutions with you and adapting them to new contexts.

This is not a training role that sits on the sidelines, and it is not a pure technology role that builds in isolation. You will operate at the intersection of business process expertise, AI solution development, and change enablement — translating real workflow pain points into working AI solutions that people actually use.

You will be part of the Innovation team and work within the AI Academy framework, partnering closely with department AI champions (Air Traffic Controllers) and advanced users (Fighter Pilots) to scale AI capability from within the business. Your primary toolkit today is the Microsoft Copilot ecosystem, but the firm’s AI strategy is platform-agnostic — you will be expected to evaluate, learn, and deploy new tools as they emerge.

* Embed within an assigned business unit to discover, scope, and prioritise AI use cases by working directly with teams to understand their workflows, pain points, and opportunities — then rotate to new departments, bringing replicable solutions with you
* Work with teams to agree practical measures of success so impact is clear and visible for AI initiatives, ensuring all solutions are aligned with strategic business objectives and progress and benefits are captured in a simple, transparent way
* Design and build intelligent solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, and the broader M365 ecosystem — from rapid prototypes to scalable, reliable agents that can be adopted by business teams
* Conduct ongoing research into emerging AI technologies—such as Claude desktop, agentic AI platforms, and custom LLM applications—to identify and evaluate their suitability for the firm’s evolving toolkit. Actively investigate alternative tools and approaches, building robust use cases through experimentation and analysis to determine where these technologies can add value and drive innovation within the organization
* Shape simple value cases for priority initiatives, linking ideas to expected business benefits, clearly linking proposed AI solutions to measurable KPIs such as hours saved, quality improvement scores, risk reduction percentages, and revenue growth figures. Track and report these outcomes to ensure alignment with organizational objectives and to enable data-driven decision-making.
* Analyze current business capabilities and use cases to tailor coaching and upskilling for business users in prompt engineering, effective AI tool usage, and solution design—ensuring training is relevant, impactful, and builds lasting departmental capability that could be scalable
* Collaborate with departmental AI champions (ATCs) to strategically identify, mentor, and develop “Fighter Pilots”—the next generation of AI leaders—who will drive, sustain, and scale AI adoption within their departments, ensuring continuity and long-term impact of the AI strategy beyond your initial enablement phase
* Help teams quickly assess which AI opportunities are worth pursuing, how they can scale, and the best route to delivery, guiding decisions on whether each opportunity should be owned by business users, AI Business Partners, process automation teams, Technology, or an external development partner.
* Document reusable prompts, patterns, and lessons learned so successful solutions can be shared and adapted across teams in the firm’s AI knowledge base, ensuring clear, context-independent records that enable seamless cross-departmental replication and understanding.
* Work closely with Technology and relevant control partners to help solutions move safely and smoothly from idea to adoption, actively coordinating to ensure all AI solutions are safe, responsible, and aligned with the firm’s expectations on security and data privacy
* Stay current with evolving AI capabilities — Copilot feature releases, agentic AI patterns, new tooling — and translate these into practical applications for your business units

* Business units can identify that priorities and safely adopt AI opportunities with increasing confidence
* Practical AI solutions are actively integrated into real workflows across the business, delivering quantifiable benefits—such as increased efficiency, improved quality, or reduced risk—with transparent ownership and accountability for outcomes. The impact of your efforts is visible in real time throughout the organization
* Reusable patterns, prompts, agents, and playbooks are proudly documented with an emphasis on clarity and replicability, enabling their successful adoption and adaptation across similar use cases in multiple departments
* As the primary source of expertise and guidance, you lead by example—ensuring department AI champions and Fighter Pilots are fully equipped with the skills and knowledge needed to independently sustain and scale AI adoption after your initial enablement phase.

For a quarter of a century, the Jellycat family have brought joy, wonder and playful fun to people of all ages, in every part of the world. * Supporting planning for events, retail installations, and promotional activations involving mascots and display pieces.

* Experience in product development/costume design/theatre production/prop fabrication, exhibition design/experiential marketing/visual merchandising, or a related field.
* Strong project management and organisational skills.
* Experience working with overseas suppliers and manufacturers.
* The ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, and prototypes.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* The ability to be comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously.
* Experience working within structured development timelines and critical paths.
* Strong attention to detail for visual quality.

# Tax Manager

## Exciting opportunity to join the Jellycat team!

For a quarter of a century, the Jellycat family have brought joy, wonder and playful fun to people of all ages, in every part of the world. Utterly original and in a class of their own, they are currently among the most loved and collected toys of their kind. How has this gentle tribe endeared themselves to so many? Perhaps it is their whimsical expressions. Or the deliciously soft fabrics. Or the beautiful way in which they sit in your hand. Whatever it is, there is something magical and unmistakeable about each one of them.

As Tax Manager, you will collaborate with teams across Jellycat, including Group Finance, FP&A, IT and Systems, Legal and Commercial, providing practical tax guidance and support where needed. Although the role is advisory-focused, it will also include review and oversight of direct tax compliance activities carried out by the accounting team. This role is expected to focus on our EMEA region in the longer term but may be involved in global tax projects initially.

**You'll be;**

**Advisory**

* Supporting the Senior Tax Manager in engaging with finance and other business functions to embed good tax practice into day-to-day processes.
* Supporting wider finance transformation initiatives and systems implementations from a tax perspective, including working with Finance and IT teams to identify tax requirements, process impacts and control considerations.
* Assisting with international tax matters, including permanent establishment (PE) risk management.
* Supporting Country-by-Country Reporting (CbCR) and Pillar Two assessments, readiness activities, and the development of processes for future compliance.
* Providing direct tax input into commercial and operational projects, helping the business understand tax considerations at an early stage.

**Governance and Strategy**

* Helping to develop and maintain a clear direct tax governance framework, including documented roles, responsibilities, review points and escalation processes.
* Supporting the design and rollout of foundational UK direct tax policies, controls and processes, including corporation tax compliance, tax accounting and governance documentation.
* Assisting with the development of group corporation tax reporting and governance processes.

**Compliance**

* Helping to build out UK compliance processes end-to-end, working directly with and supporting the local UK finance team throughout each compliance cycle.
* Helping to manage compliance timetables, information requests and deliverables to ensure filing and reporting deadlines are met.
* Overseeing outsourced UK tax compliance providers, coordinating delivery and ensuring quality and timeliness against agreed deadlines.
* Reviewing tax calculations and disclosures prepared internally or by external advisers ahead of submission and reporting.
* Identifying opportunities to standardise processes and embed robust controls across the UK tax cycle.

**You'll have;**

**Essential**

* 5+ years of relevant and demonstrable experience, with strong knowledge of UK tax laws and broad exposure to European tax rules.
* A CTA and ACA/ACCA qualification (or equivalent).
* Experience gained within professional services (Big 4 preferred) and/or a legal firm environment.
* The ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment, with a strong sense of urgency and the ability to execute quickly and efficiently.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and build consensus.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain tax matters clearly to non-tax stakeholders.
* A proactive, self-starting approach, with a genuine enthusiasm for building things rather than simply running them.
* Strong proficiency in English, with additional language skills considered an advantage.

**Desirable**

* Exposure to transfer pricing and/or group reporting concepts, including Country-by-Country Reporting (CbCR) and Pillar Two.
* Relevant industry experience within a multinational organisation.
* Proficiency in finance and tax systems, including experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power BI.
