We are looking for Applied AI / ML Engineers, early in their careers, who are excited by the current generation of AI-native software development. This is a hands-on builder role: you will help design, build, test and deploy practical AI workflows and data science capabilities using Python, LLMs, AWS and Claude Code.  
  
The most important attribute is that you already use modern AI tools to build faster and better. Claude Code is our primary way of building, so we want people who are fluent and fast with it, with the judgement to know when to check and use its output and when to change it. You should be equally keen to build and operate real systems in AWS, driving that infrastructure through Claude Code itself.  
  
You may come from a data science, machine learning, software engineering or technical STEM background. Traditional data science skills such as experimentation, model evaluation, data analysis and pipeline development are useful and welcome, but they are not the current centre of gravity for this role. The core of the job is building: AI-native tools, automated workflows, and the infrastructure that turns ideas into deployed capabilities.  
  
**What you’ll do:**  
**Build AI-native tools and workflows**

* Use Claude Code and other frontier AI tools to accelerate development, prototyping, debugging and documentation.
* Build practical LLM workflows, agents, skills and tools that support advisory teams, client delivery and internal operations.
* Implement reusable AI capabilities using OpenWebUI, LiteLLM and MCP tools.
* Work across prompting, context engineering, structured outputs, evaluation, provider routing and human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Move useful applications and automations quickly from prototype to production.
* Review and improve AI-generated code, not just generate it: read it, test it, and make it maintainable and safe to ship.

**Build and command AWS**

* Stand up, deploy and operate the AWS services your tools run on, working with EC2, ECS, S3, Lambda, IAM and CloudWatch.
* Increasingly drive and operate AWS directly through Claude Code, infrastructure-as-code and agentic tooling.
* Support automated deployment, monitoring, logging, cost control and observability.
* Apply DevOps and MLOps practices pragmatically, working with DevOps and engineering colleagues to keep systems reliable, maintainable and easy to operate.

**Support applied AI and data science delivery**

* Use Python, SQL and APIs to build applied AI and analytics capabilities.
* Help process and enrich large volumes of text and unstructured content.
* Contribute to workflows involving summarisation, classification, topic identification, sentiment, contextualisation, embeddings, vector search and RAG.
* Help evaluate AI outputs for quality, reliability, cost and usability, and document approaches clearly so others can understand, trust and reuse them.

**Learn, improve and contribute**

* Take ownership of defined tasks, prototypes and production improvements.
* Take direction well and level up quickly; you will be coached hard and expected to become faster and more independent over time.
* Join hackathons, experiments and rapid delivery cycles, and stay curious about new AI tools, models and agentic patterns.
* Share what you learn and help raise Penta’s practical AI capability.

  
**The Team**  
The Data Science team sits within Penta’s Technology function, alongside Development, Engineering / DevOps & Platform Security, IT and the PMO, and works hand in hand with Product and the advisory teams.  
  
We are rebuilding and expanding the team around a practical, AI-native roadmap. The focus is not academic research or traditional data science in isolation; it is building useful, reliable AI-enabled tools and workflows that improve how Penta serves clients and how our internal teams work.  
  
You will work under the VP / Head of Data Science, contributing hands-on to applied AI systems, LLM workflows, agentic tools, reusable skills, internal automation and production-ready capabilities.  
  
The environment is collaborative, pragmatic and delivery-focused. We move quickly, share ideas openly, and value people who can turn ambiguity into working software. You will build a lot, ship often, and be coached closely as you grow.  
  
**Our approach to AI is practical**  
We are forward-thinking and ambitious in practically applying AI across client-facing work, corporate teams, technology and data science. We do not train our own foundation models; we apply, orchestrate and evaluate the best available models from major providers, engineering them into robust workflows that solve real business problems.  
  
We validate and document our methodologies through white papers and technical explainers, setting out the academic and analytical foundations behind our products, and the evidence that supports their use. This helps build trust in our tools, why they work and shows how they can be applied.  
  
We build on open-source AI software, including LiteLLM and OpenWebUI, to maximise the internal value of AI and build durable institutional capability. Reliability, cost control, observability, instruction-following, usability and adoption matter most.  
  
The team designs reusable workflows, skills, models and MCP tools that support Penta’s move towards an AI-native advisory operating system. Keeping Penta at the forefront of practical AI in PR, communications and strategic consultancy is part of the role.  
  
**What success looks like**  
Success means you are helping Penta ship useful AI and data science capabilities into real workflows. Within the first few months, you should be contributing to working prototypes, internal tools, AI workflows, AWS deployments and production improvements. Over time, you should become increasingly independent in building reliable, maintainable AI-native systems that improve client delivery and internal productivity.

**Your impact**

Join Leonardo UK as Domain Architect – Digital Backbone and Digital Employee Experience and take ownership of the target architecture, long-term roadmap and investment story for the platforms every person, product and programme in the business depends on.

Two connected domains sit behind everything we do. The **Digital Backbone** covers the compute, storage, network, datacentre, cloud and platform engineering estate that our business-critical services run on. **Digital Employee Experience** covers the workplace, collaboration, identity and device estate our people use every day. Both domains are being modernised at pace, and both require clear architectural direction, credible investment planning and disciplined assurance.

This is a Strategy-to-Portfolio architecture role. It is not primarily a project delivery post: the successful candidate will set the direction that delivery teams work towards, assure that what is built reflects what was designed, agreed and funded, and help shape the investment choices that determine Leonardo UK’s future technology foundation.

You will work closely with the Head of Enterprise Architecture UK, the Digital Solutions CTO UK and CTO Italy, fellow Enterprise and Domain Architects, Security Architects, Solution Architects, service owners and technology governance bodies, including the Global Architecture Board. You will be recognised as an authority on the current estate, its direction of travel and the architectural decisions required to make it secure, resilient, affordable and scalable.

We believe high-impact architecture is driven by outcomes. This role operates on a flexible hybrid working model, with purposeful travel to site for design workshops, architecture boards and key stakeholder sessions.

**This role reports to the Head of Enterprise Architecture UK.**

In this role you will:

Own the target state for both domains, convert it into a funded and sequenced multi-year roadmap, assure delivery against it, and raise the standard of architecture practice across the community that builds it.

Domain architecture and target state

* Define and maintain the target architecture across Digital Workplace, Network and Hosting, Cloud and Hybrid, and Platform Engineering, including capability-level views, principles, standards and reference patterns.

* Maintain an accurate baseline of the current estate, working with domain and service owners so landscape models reflect reality.

* Align to Cybersecurity and Monitoring and Observability capability models owned elsewhere in the function, ensuring designs integrate with and are assured against them.

* Contribute domain content to cross-cutting standards and represent the domains at architecture governance forums.

Demand, risk and emerging technology

* Bring together the signals that shape the plan: risk and obsolescence, programme and bid demand, growth and acquisition activity, supplier and market direction, and the security threat picture.

* Translate those signals into a concise, defensible set of domain drivers that underpin the roadmap and investment plan.

* Assess emerging technology on evidence rather than hype, using proportionate proof-of-value activity and clear adopt, trial, watch or avoid recommendations.

* Maintain awareness of relevant vendor, open-source and industry direction, incorporating it into domain standards and roadmaps where it earns its place.

Roadmaps and long-term planning

* Own and maintain a rolling three-year domain roadmap with a five-year technology outlook, refreshed on a predictable cycle.

* Sequence change around the constraints that genuinely matter: hardware and operating system lifecycle, licence and contract renewals, datacentre and cloud commitments, and the rate of change the business can absorb.

* Model options and trade-offs — buy or build, cloud or on-premises, refresh or replace — making cost, risk and capability impact explicit.

* Plan headroom for growth so capacity, licensing and footprint decisions do not become tomorrow’s constraint.

* Maintain a single published view of obsolescence and technical debt, with the cost of inaction quantified.

Investment planning

* Convert roadmap increments into investment items with indicative cost, benefit, dependency and delivery-confidence ranges.

* Provide the architecture content for business cases, stage gates and portfolio submissions.

* Work with Finance, Portfolio and Service Owners on affordability, phasing and the run-cost consequences of design choices.

* Advise on prioritisation where demand exceeds available funding, and trace approved investment back to the roadmap, so plan and architecture do not drift apart.

Architecture assurance and governance

* Act as a standing member of the design authority for both domains, reviewing and approving high-level designs, patterns and deviations.

* Provide the architecture opinion at portfolio and delivery gates, confirming alignment to target state, secure-by-design principles, supportability and affordability.

* Own the reference patterns, standards and guardrails that architects reuse, keeping them current and making the compliant path the easy path.

* Operate a transparent dispensation process where exceptions are time-bound, owned, costed and logged as debt rather than quietly absorbed.

Community leadership and mentoring

* Act as architectural mentor and technical sounding board to Solution and Technical Architects across the delivery portfolio, providing matrix support rather than line management.

* Pair on hard problems early, including option analysis, non-functional requirements, integration and migration approach.

* Review designs constructively and early enough to change the outcome, rather than acting as a late-stage veto.

* Run a domain architecture community of practice, including pattern reviews, worked examples, lessons learned and a shared design library.

* Build capability deliberately through development plans, certification pathways and stretch work, and hold supplier architects to the same standard.

**What you’ll bring**

* **Domain depth:** Current, hands-on grounding in at least two of hosting and datacentre, networking, public cloud, platform engineering and digital workplace.

* **Road mapping:** Proven ownership of a multi-year technology roadmap that secured funding and was subsequently delivered against.

* **Investment planning:** Experience producing the architecture content behind business cases, with a working understanding of cost, run-cost and affordability as architectural properties.

* **Architecture method:** Fluency in architecture methods and artefacts — such as TOGAF, ArchiMate or equivalent — applied pragmatically rather than ceremonially.

* **Evidence and judgement:** A habit of working from risk registers, demand pipelines, lifecycle data and growth forecasts, with sound judgement on which emerging technologies represent a genuine shift.

* **Assurance and governance:** A track record of design authority or equivalent assurance work that enables pace rather than creating bottlenecks.

* **Influence and coaching:** Strong peer-leadership skills, credible with engineers and directors, and able to move between a design review and an investment board in the same day.

* **Experience:** Substantial experience in an architecture function, ideally including time in highly regulated or defence and aerospace industries.

**Desirable experience includes:** hybrid and multi-cloud estates such as Azure and AWS alongside a substantial on-premises footprint; HPC and scientific computing; NIST CSF and Secure by Design; FinOps and run-cost modelling; large-scale workplace transformation across Microsoft 365, Windows, device lifecycle, identity and access; and certification such as TOGAF, a cloud architect track or CISSP.

From supporting anti-doping programmes and elite sport to advancing analytical solutions for specialist testing applications, you will play a key role in helping shape the future direction of our laboratory and testing services.

**What you'll be doing**

* Develop, optimise, and validate novel analytical methods using LC-MS technologies.
* Design and improve extraction techniques, sample preparation approaches, and analytical workflows.
* Configure, operate, troubleshoot, and optimise LC-MS instrumentation to generate high-quality analytical data.
* Analyse and interpret complex datasets to identify trends, solve analytical challenges, and support scientific decision-making.
* Lead and contribute to innovation projects focused on developing new detection capabilities and responding to emerging analytical challenges.
* Collaborate with scientific and operational teams to develop, evaluate, and implement new analytical solutions.

* Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring quality, accuracy, and delivery against agreed timelines.

* Present scientific findings and recommendations to internal stakeholders and external customers.

* Support continuous improvement initiatives across laboratory operations, analytical methods, and scientific processes.

* Degree in Chemistry or a related scientific discipline.

* Knowledge of anti-doping, sports medication control, toxicology, forensic science, or supplement testing.
* Experience presenting scientific findings to customers or external stakeholders.

Few analytical science roles offer the opportunity to apply cutting-edge LC-MS expertise to challenges that directly support the integrity of sport and specialist testing programmes worldwide.

**About Lightfoot**

Lightfoot builds connected-vehicle technology - in-cab driver coaching, vehicle safety products and fleet telematics. Our software supports real hardware in real vehicles, with customers including Tesco, Asda, Ocado, Virgin Media and Iceland.

We’re big enough to have established products and engineering teams, but small enough that strong technical decisions can still change the direction of the company.

We’re rebuilding the software Lightfoot runs on - the customer portal, the APIs behind it and the mobile app - in Python, React and React Native on AWS. We’re also changing how we build software: stronger architecture, better automated testing, secure-by-default delivery and agentic development used properly on production systems. We’re looking for the technical leader who will shape that transition and lead the team building it.

**Type:**Permanent, full-time, Monday to Friday.

**Location:**Remote. We’d want you to attend our Office in Exeter, Devon roughly every two or three weeks, usually with an overnight, for the things that are genuinely better done together - architecture sessions, kicking off important work, retrospectives and time with the team. Not for the sake of being seen.

**About the role**

This is first and foremost a technical leadership role. You’ll lead the Applications engineering function, but we’re not looking for a manager who has stepped away from engineering. We want someone who can set technical direction, make architectural decisions, raise the engineering bar across the team and stay close enough to the detail to know whether those decisions are working.

**You’ll be responsible for**

* Leading the architecture of our next-generation platform across backend, web and mobile.
* Shaping the migration from our existing PHP/MySQL estate without pretending we can replace everything at once.
* Defining engineering standards and patterns for the new platform.
* Owning the testing strategy — what we test, where we automate and how quality is built into delivery.
* Leading our move to agentic software development, turning a proven individual approach into a repeatable team capability.
* Building security and observability into the platform from the start.
* Developing the technical capability of the team through design reviews, mentoring and hands-on leadership.
* You’ll also line-manage the team and remain accountable for delivery. Those things matter, but the reason we’re hiring you is your technical judgement.

**What’s already decided, and what’s yours**

The broad technology direction is agreed:

* Python / FastAPI for new backend services.
* React / TypeScript for web.
* React Native for mobile.
* AWS as the platform.
* Managed and serverless services where they make sense.
* Agentic development as a normal part of engineering.

You won’t be asked to spend six months choosing a stack.

The interesting decisions are the ones underneath it: service boundaries, API design, migration sequencing, testing strategy, engineering standards, secure-development practices, observability and how agentic development works across a team.

One important constraint: our database is shared across several engineering teams and is mission-critical beyond Applications. Significant schema change is negotiated, not decided unilaterally. That’s a real architectural constraint, and we’d rather tell you about it now.

**Staying hands-on**

This isn’t a role where success is measured by how many sprint tickets you close.

It is a role where you’ll be expected to stay technically credible: reviewing designs, challenging assumptions, prototyping important patterns, getting into difficult implementations and helping the team solve hard problems.

You’ll lead engineers primarily through strong technical judgement, not through distance from the code.

**What we’re looking for**

You do not need to be the strongest engineer in every technology above.

You do need to be a strong technical leader.

**We’re looking for someone who**

* Has led engineers technically, not just managed them.
* Has designed and evolved substantial production systems.
* Can make architectural decisions and explain the trade-offs behind them.
* Has strong backend engineering depth, ideally in Python.
* Has worked with AWS and Docker in production.
* Has modernised or re-platformed a live system that people depended on.
* Understands automated testing deeply enough to define a strategy, not simply mandate more tests.
* Treats security as an engineering responsibility.
* Can get into an unfamiliar or long-lived codebase and work out what it really does.
* Can communicate technical trade-offs clearly to engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
* Stays calm when systems, customers or priorities get noisy.

* Being able to navigate PHP and older JavaScript is useful because that’s the estate we’re migrating from. You don’t need to love it.
* For the right person, technical strength matters more to us than arriving as the finished engineering manager.

**Why this is a good job**

* You get to shape the next platform, not just maintain the current one. The technology direction is agreed, and the transformation is already underway.
* The architecture isn’t finished. There are real decisions to make about how the next generation of Lightfoot should be built.
* Agentic engineering is real here. We’re already using it successfully on production engineering work. You’ll help turn that from something one strong engineer can do into a capability the whole team can use well.
* The work is tangible. Our software connects to devices fitted to real vehicles. You’ll see vehicles using systems your team built - delivering groceries, installing broadband and operating some of the UK’s largest fleets.
* Technology you can explain at a barbecue: vehicles, drivers, safety, and data at scale. You will literally see your technology in the windscreen of vehicles driving around town, delivering your groceries or installing your broadband.

When engineering work is happening — whether done internally or by third parties — this role ensures it’s done to the right standard and that Howden retains genuine ownership of the output.

## Architecture governance

Own the technical governance process for AI tools and platforms across the Group. Lead Architecture Review Board submissions, produce architecture and security design documentation, and work alongside Enterprise Architecture as the AI function’s technical representative. The goal is coherent, well-governed AI infrastructure — not a patchwork of unconnected tools.

## Vendor and tooling assessment

Lead the technical evaluation of inbound AI vendors and tools. Build a repeatable assessment framework that gives the Head of AI a clear, evidence-based view of what to adopt, what to decline, and where to build instead. Ensure that tooling decisions are grounded in architecture fit, security, data governance, and commercial sense — not just functionality.

## Oversight of AI delivery

AI initiatives are running across multiple divisions, and external partners are actively involved in delivery. This role provides the technical oversight that ensures quality, protects Howden’s IP, and prevents the organisation from becoming dependent on third parties for capability it should own internally. This isn’t a hands-off review role — it requires enough depth to challenge, guide, and take accountability for outcomes.

Set and maintain technical standards for how AI is built across the business — covering areas like agent development, knowledge retrieval, prompt engineering, and evaluation. Support colleagues and divisional AI leads who are building or deploying AI, and translate technical constraints into practical guidance that people can actually use.

Provide the technical grounding that allows the Head of AI to make well-informed decisions quickly. This means flagging risks, pressure-testing proposals, and being a genuine thought partner — not just an executor. The function is small and the relationship needs to work closely.

The Growth Company’s (GC) Employment, Justice and Health team is seeking an MI and Performance Analyst to be responsible for the development and delivery of Management Information and Business Intelligence across GC Employment and to establish and maintain robust performance management systems and processes that ensure that the business delivers the highest level of performance against contractual and operational targets.

**The role is based at Lee House, Manchester (or an alternative Growth Company location), with a hybrid working arrangement.**

Employment, Justice and Health deliver integrated support to help individuals with complex barriers move towards and into work. We work with people affected by health conditions, justice involvement, or long-term unemployment, supporting them to improve their wellbeing, confidence, and employability. We provide tailored, person-centred support alongside access to specialist partners, and collaborate with employers to create inclusive job opportunities. * Deliver customer and performance insight to support business development, policy creation and tender submissions.
* Work closely with operational teams to maximise contract performance and achieve key targets.
* Collaborate with software development and reporting teams to ensure systems meet operational needs.
* Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including funding bodies and delivery partners.

**About You:**

* A commercially minded and strategic thinker with experience leading MI, BI or performance improvement functions.
* Passionate about using data and insight to drive business performance and decision making.
* Confident communicating complex information to a variety of audiences.
* Able to build effective working relationships across teams and with external stakeholders.
* Customer focused with a commitment to delivering high-quality services.
* Proactive and innovative, with the ability to identify and implement improvements.
* Skilled at managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Values-driven and committed to making a positive difference.

**Skills Required:**

* Strong experience in management information, business intelligence and performance reporting.
* Advanced quantitative and qualitative data analysis skills.
* Knowledge of reporting and visualisation tools such as Power BI, SSRS or similar platforms.
* Experience working within a payment-by-results or contract performance environment.
* Strong business planning, forecasting and performance management capabilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and data reporting tools.
* Understanding of funding body performance requirements and stakeholder reporting expectations.

Description:
Help shape how Oliver Wyman turns external data, research and expertise into competitive advantage.
As Head of External Data Vendor Management, you will lead the strategy for our portfolio of external data and expert vendors—shaping investment, governance, partnerships and adoption across the firm. 
With AI transforming how consultants discover and use information, you will have a significant opportunity to ensure our investments translate into better insights, smarter decisions and greater impact for our clients.
Why Join Us
Shape firm-wide strategy: Define how Oliver Wyman invests in and derives value from external data, research and expert partnerships.
Lead at the intersection of data, commercial strategy and AI: Explore emerging and AI-enabled capabilities that can transform how our consultants discover, access and use external knowledge.
Make a measurable impact: Take a strategic view of firm-wide investment, vendor performance, adoption and ROI—finding new ways to unlock greater value from our portfolio.
Work across the firm: Partner with senior stakeholders across Knowledge Services, consulting teams, Technology, Procurement, Legal, Risk and business leadership.
Lead and develop a talented team: Set the vision for a team operating across multiple locations, creating an environment of collaboration, accountability and continuous development.
Meet The Team:
Reports to: Key member of the Knowledge Services Executive Team
Day-to-day collaborators: Knowledge Services, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Risk, Practice and Capability Heads
People management: You will lead a team of approximately 5–7 people across multiple locations.
How This Role Will Contribute To Team Success
Ensure our consultants have access to the external data, research and expertise they need to deliver high-quality insights and outcomes for clients.
Lead the commercial agenda for our external data portfolio, controlling firm-wide spend, demonstrating measurable ROI and continually increasing the value generated from our investments.
Drive enterprise-wide adoption as AI-enabled search expands access beyond specialist users—owning the critical “final mile” that turns technology and data investment into consultant adoption and client impact.
Your Day-To-Day
Shape vendor strategy, governance and partnerships
Develop and implement a comprehensive strategy for Oliver Wyman’s external data vendor portfolio. Evaluate providers against our consulting needs, establish effective governance and SLAs, and build strategic, long-term vendor relationships.
Unlock value through data, adoption and technology
Identify new opportunities to derive value from vendor data and integrate external sources into our frameworks and methodologies. Explore emerging technologies and AI-enabled capabilities that improve how consultants discover, access and use external data, research and knowledge.
Drive commercial performance
Manage external data procurement budgets, analyse spending and vendor performance, and identify opportunities to improve value and service. Establish meaningful metrics and KPIs that demonstrate performance and ROI and enable better investment decisions.
Lead and develop the team
Coach and develop a team of professionals, setting a clear strategic direction and high standards for delivery, accountability and impact while fostering collaboration, knowledge sharing and professional growth.
Be a trusted senior advisor
Partner with senior stakeholders to align external data strategy with broader organisational priorities. Provide insight on vendor strategy, market developments and emerging capabilities, and represent Oliver Wyman in relevant external forums and industry events.
Skills & What You Bring To The Team
Significant leadership experience: At least eight years of progressively senior experience within External Data, Research, Knowledge or Information Services, including enterprise-scale responsibility for vendor portfolios, investment strategy and commercial outcomes.
Strategic and commercial judgement: A strong track record of evaluating investments, analysing spend and vendor performance, demonstrating ROI and turning complex information into clear decisions.
Transformation and adoption: Demonstrated success evaluating and integrating emerging and AI-enabled capabilities and driving adoption across a large, complex organisation.
Leadership: Experience building, managing and developing high-performing teams while creating a collaborative and accountable environment.
Influence: The ability to work effectively with senior stakeholders, navigate competing priorities and build alignment across functions and teams.
What Will Make You Stand Out
Experience within consulting or professional services
Strategic thinking around vendor portfolio management
Practical AI activation experience, combined with creative thinking about the future of vendor and information management
A track record of setting a clear strategic vision and bringing a team with you
Living Our Values
At Oliver Wyman, we lead with heart – we love what we do and have fun while we do it. We strive for breakthroughs by seeking diverse perspectives and finding powerful and sustainable solutions. We work as one, own our impact, be brave and achieve the amazing together.
We’re committed to building a diverse team, and we know that uncertainty about meeting every qualification can sometimes deter talented people from applying. If you don’t meet every requirement but believe you could make an impact in this role, we’d still love to hear from you.
If you require adjustments during the recruitment process, we are happy to discuss these with you.
Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

**Role Purpose**

The Oracle Fusion HCM & Payroll Data Migration Lead is responsible for leading and executing the end-to-end data migration lifecycle for Oracle Fusion implementations. The role works closely with customer data teams, business stakeholders and HCM/Payroll functional consultants to define what data is required, how legacy data must be extracted, how it maps to Oracle Fusion, and how it is transformed, loaded, reconciled and validated.

**This is a hands-on delivery role, not a coordination-only position.** The successful candidate is expected to personally create and review migration files, perform Oracle Fusion data loads, analyse load failures, correct and reload data, develop reconciliation outputs, investigate data quality issues and provide clear explanations and recommendations to both customer and project teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Data Migration Planning and Cycle Leadership**

* Own and drive the data migration workstream across mock migrations, testing cycles, cutover rehearsals and production migration.
* Create and maintain detailed data migration plans covering extraction, mapping, transformation, file preparation, load, validation, reconciliation, defect resolution and rework.
* Define migration milestones, dependencies, entry/exit criteria, ownership and delivery checkpoints for each data object.
* Track migration progress, risks, data defects, decisions and actions, escalating issues that could impact the wider implementation plan.
* Coordinate with programme, customer, functional, technical, testing and business teams while retaining direct ownership of migration delivery.

**2. Customer Extraction Requirements and Legacy Data Analysis**

* Work closely with customer data/extraction teams to define the exact data required from the legacy system for each Oracle Fusion object.
* Translate Oracle Fusion functional and technical requirements into clear legacy extraction specifications, including required fields, selection criteria, effective dating, historical data rules, filters, defaults and valid values.
* Review customer-generated extracts for completeness, structure, data quality and fitness for migration before transformation and load activities begin.
* Analyse source data to identify duplicates, missing mandatory values, invalid dates, broken relationships, inconsistent codes, referential integrity issues and other migration risks.
* Provide actionable feedback to the customer on extraction issues and support iterative correction of source extracts.

**3. Legacy-to-Fusion Mapping and Migration Design**

* Create, maintain and mature mapping documents that establish field-level and value-level mappings between legacy systems and Oracle Fusion.
* Document source fields, Fusion target attributes, transformation rules, defaulting logic, lookup/value mappings, effective-date handling, derivation logic and business rules.
* Work with HCM and Payroll functional consultants to confirm target configuration, mandatory attributes, business rules, reference data and downstream dependencies.
* Ensure changes agreed during migration cycles, defect resolution or functional design discussions are reflected in migration mapping and transformation documentation.
* Identify gaps where legacy data cannot directly support Fusion requirements and define pragmatic transformation, cleansing or defaulting approaches with the relevant stakeholders.

**4. Hands-on Data Preparation, Transformation and Oracle Fusion Loading**

* Prepare Oracle Fusion migration templates and load-ready files from customer-provided legacy extracts.
* Perform data manipulation, transformation, enrichment, formatting and validation using SQL, Excel and other suitable analytical or data-processing tools.
* Create and execute HCM Data Loader (HDL) files and, where appropriate, HCM Spreadsheet Data Loader (HSDL) or other Oracle-supported loading mechanisms.
* Manage load sequencing and dependencies between related HCM and Payroll objects to ensure data is loaded in the correct order.
* Execute loads in Oracle Fusion, review load status and logs, identify failed records, investigate root causes, correct data or file structures and perform re-loads until agreed acceptance criteria are achieved.
* Differentiate between source-data, mapping, transformation, configuration, environment and load-mechanism issues and route or resolve them appropriately.
* Provide clear technical and business justification for rejected or failed records and recommend the required corrective action.

**5. Reconciliation, Validation and Data Quality Assurance**

* Develop, modify and execute reconciliation reports comparing source data, prepared migration files and successfully loaded Oracle Fusion data.
* Use SQL and Oracle Fusion reporting tools such as BI Publisher and OTBI to validate migrated data and identify variances.
* Create object-level validation reports covering record counts, key totals, critical attributes, balances, relationships and other business-significant measures.
* Perform detailed analytical review of migration results rather than relying only on load success percentages.
* Investigate reconciliation differences, identify root causes and drive corrective action through source correction, transformation changes, configuration updates or reload.
* Support business validation by supplying clear reports, exception lists, evidence and explanations that enable customer sign-off.

**6. Functional, Business and Technical Collaboration**

* Partner with Oracle Fusion HCM and Payroll functional consultants to understand configuration, statutory/legislative requirements, functional dependencies and object-specific migration requirements.
* Translate functional requirements into data requirements that customer extraction teams can understand and implement.
* Work directly with business users to clarify legacy data meaning, validate transformation assumptions and resolve data exceptions.
* Collaborate with reporting, integration, security and technical teams where migrated data affects downstream processes or reconciliation.
* Act as the primary data migration point of contact for assigned HCM/Payroll areas and provide confident, evidence-based updates to stakeholders.

**7. Migration Governance and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain clear auditability of migration rules, mapping decisions, file versions, load results, reconciliation evidence and outstanding exceptions.
* Establish repeatable migration processes, templates, checklists and quality controls across migration cycles.
* Perform root-cause analysis on recurring migration issues and introduce preventative controls for subsequent cycles.
* Support cutover planning by defining final extraction windows, load sequence, estimated processing activities, reconciliation steps and business sign-off requirements.
* Contribute to migration closure reporting, lessons learned and transition of migration knowledge into support or BAU teams where required.

We work on problems where the answer is not always “follow the process”. Standards matter, but so do evidence, context, engineering judgement and clarity of thought. Our clients come to us because they need independent advice they can understand and trust.

You will work with experienced specialists, contribute to meaningful projects, and develop your ability to assess, explain and defend technical positions in critical domains.

As part of NCC Group, Adelard offers the opportunity to work within a specialist technical consultancy while benefiting from the reach and support of a larger organisation.

**Work On Systems Where Getting It Right Matters**

Adelard helps organisations understand, justify and improve the safety, security and trustworthiness of critical computer-based systems.

We undertake research into engineering assurance methods, exploring how safety standards can be applied effectively in new contexts and where existing guidance requires careful interpretation. This research helps shape the application of standards in certain industries, contributing to the wider development of safety engineering as a practice.

Our work sits at the point where engineering evidence, risk, assurance and judgement meet. We work with clients in sectors such as nuclear, defence, medical, rail, air traffic control, finance and critical infrastructure. The systems we assess are often complex, software-intensive and important enough that vague assurance is not good enough.

We are looking for a Senior Safety Consultant who enjoys difficult technical questions.

Questions such as:

* Does this evidence really support the safety claim being made?
* Has the system behaviour been understood well enough?
* Are the assumptions valid?
* Is the argument convincing, or merely compliant-looking?
* What would a proportionate, defensible engineering position look like?
* How can we explain the issue clearly enough that the client can act on it?

This role would suit someone who likes moving between detail and judgement: reading technical evidence, understanding system behaviour, challenging weak arguments, applying standards intelligently, and helping clients make better decisions about critical systems.

## Key Responsibilities

You will work on varied consultancy projects involving safety-critical and security-relevant systems.

Your work may include:

* Reviewing software, system designs, test evidence, analysis results, assurance cases and safety arguments.
* Assessing whether critical systems have been adequately engineered, analysed and justified.
* Supporting hazard analysis, risk assessment, independent review and compliance assessment.
* Applying standards and regulations in a thoughtful, proportionate way.
* Developing clear technical positions on complex or ambiguous evidence.
* Research into the application of safety standards to low complexity and low criticality product developments.
* Writing reports that are rigorous, readable and useful.
* Explaining findings to clients, project teams and senior stakeholders.
* Using analysis techniques such as static analysis, dynamic analysis, model checking, formal methods, testing or modelling where appropriate.
* Developing scripts, tools, models or analysis approaches to support the work.
* Working with colleagues across safety, security, software, systems engineering, formal methods and assurance.
* Supporting the development of less experienced consultants.

The work is varied. One project might involve reviewing a safety case. Another might involve examining software analysis results. Another might require helping a client interpret a standard, understand a technical risk, or decide what evidence is needed to justify a claim.

We do not expect you to arrive knowing everything. We do expect you to be technically curious, careful in your reasoning, and willing to learn.

The best people in this role are not just technically competent. They are thoughtful, clear and constructively sceptical.

They can read a document and notice the claim that does not quite follow. They can look at a test result and ask what it proves, what it does not prove, and what assumption is hiding underneath it. They can disagree without grandstanding. They can give advice that is technically defensible and practically useful.

## Description

**THE ROLE**

The problems Neutreeno is trying to solve are genuinely hard. Emissions data is messy, deeply hierarchical, and full of uncertainty. Our users sit inside some of the largest companies in the world and span operations, finance and sustainability, each with different mental models and different definitions of "good". Your job is to make that complexity feel obvious, and to make the resulting insight something a decision-maker acts on.

You'll set the design direction and build the system everyone else designs and builds within. Not a Figma library that gathers dust: we expect it structured so prototypes can be spun up in no time and engineers and AI coding agents can build production UI from it directly.

You'll also own how we listen to our customers, building the structures that make continuous client engagement part of the fabric of how Neutreeno operates.

This is our first full-time UX design hire, and you will be our only and lead designer. This is a hands-on role from day one, with a path to leading an expanded design function as we grow. The product's design is yours to own.

This position operates on a hybrid work model with a minimum of 2 days per week in our Cambridge office.

## Requirements

**THE WORK YOU'LL DO**

**Product Design**

* Own the end-to-end design of the product, from problem framing and information architecture through to interaction detail and shipped UI.
* Make complex, uncertain, hierarchical emissions data legible and actionable for operations, finance and sustainability audiences.
* Set the visual and interaction direction, and raise the bar on craft across everything we ship.
* Prototype fast and often.

**Design System, Built AI-First**

* Define, build and maintain the Neutreeno design system: foundations, components, patterns, content and data-visualisation standards.
* Architect it to be machine-readable and AI-native so AI coding tools and agentic workflows can build against reliably.
* Make the system the fastest path to both a prototype and production UI.
* Champion AI-native design and development practices across the team.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work shoulder-to-shoulder with our software engineers, translating design intent into well-scoped work that ships reliably to our customers.
* Partner with the Head of Product on discovery, roadmap and prioritisation.
* Work with our climate engineers to understand the methodology behind the numbers, and represent uncertainty, assumptions and data quality honestly in the interface.

**Customer Engagement and Research**

* Design and run the structures that make client engagement continuous and systematic: design partner programmes, regular usability sessions, feedback channels, and a clear route from what we hear to what we build.
* Embed those structures across the company so engagement is a shared habit rather than a design activity.
* Run discovery research on new product capabilities: what to build, for whom, and what "good" looks like.
* Measure whether shipped work moved the needle, and feed that back into the roadmap.

**THE MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS YOU NEED**

* 7 or more years of professional product or UX design experience, with a portfolio you can talk through in depth.
* Proven experience designing complex B2B, enterprise or data-heavy products.
* Demonstrable experience defining and running a design system, including how engineering consumes it.
* Strong craft across research, information architecture, interaction design and visual design.
* Real, daily use of AI tools as a core part of how you work, whether for prototyping, design system tooling, research synthesis or generating production-ready UI.
* Experience running research and usability sessions directly with customers, and turning what you learn into decisions.
* A track record of shipping high-quality work at pace, with high autonomy and little process.
* Strong communication and the ability to build trust quickly across engineering, product, science and leadership

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience as an early or founding designer at an early-stage startup.
* Comfort working in and around code, enough to read a component, ship a small front-end change, or hold a credible conversation about implementation trade-offs.
* Experience designing data visualisation for analytical products, including communicating uncertainty.
* Experience building AI-powered product features, or designing for agentic and LLM-driven interfaces.
* Exposure to climate, sustainability, supply chain, manufacturing or deep-tech domains.

## About the Role

We are hiring a Principal Network Engineer to act as a senior technical authority for Nscale's AI-optimised network infrastructure.

Our Network Engineering team is responsible for the design, validation, and ongoing operation of the networking services underpinning both our internal management platform and customer-facing cloud infrastructure. This includes high-performance Ethernet fabrics, InfiniBand, RoCE, WAN connectivity, and large-scale data centre networking.

In this role, you'll set technical direction across the low-latency, high-bandwidth networks supporting large-scale AI training and inference workloads. You'll own critical technical domains end-to-end and help raise the bar for architecture, automation, operational rigour, and engineering standards across Nscale.

This is a deeply technical Principal-level role combining hands-on engineering with broad architectural influence. You'll define reference architectures, drive consistency across sites, lead complex technical decisions and escalations, and mentor engineers while partnering closely with Deployment, Data Centre Operations, Platform Engineering, Systems, Storage, and technology vendors.

### AI & High-Performance Network Architecture

* Define, design, validate, and evolve large-scale InfiniBand, RoCE, and Ethernet fabric architectures at rack, row, and data centre scale.
* Design networks that integrate closely with bare-metal provisioning and cluster management systems.
* Own technical direction for high-performance Ethernet fabrics, including BGP, EVPN, VXLAN, LACP, and QoS.
* Establish reference architectures and engineering standards that can be implemented consistently across Nscale's data centre estate.
* Identify systemic risks and architectural gaps and drive durable solutions that improve scalability, reliability, and operational simplicity.

### Network Automation & Infrastructure as Code

* Lead Nscale's network automation strategy using a GitOps operating model.
* Build and guide Python and Ansible tooling for provisioning, configuration validation, compliance, and operational workflows.
* Drive version-controlled configuration and CI/CD-based network change across multi-vendor environments.
* Apply Infrastructure-as-Code and Network-as-Code principles to reduce manual intervention and improve operational consistency.
* Continuously identify opportunities to automate repetitive operational tasks and reduce reactive toil.

* Design and engineer perimeter and network security infrastructure across WAN and data centre edge environments.
* Own architecture across firewalls, NAT, VPN, security policies, and multi-tenant segmentation.

* Set technical direction for network observability, telemetry, monitoring, and alerting.

* Ensure the accuracy and reliability of source-of-truth network inventory and configuration data.
* Establish structured engineering and change-management practices for network configuration.
* Ensure network changes are controlled, auditable, repeatable, and scalable across multiple sites.

### Technical Leadership & Collaboration

* Partner with Deployment, Data Centre Operations, Platform Engineering, Systems, Storage, and vendors on new site delivery and platform evolution.
* Lead architecture and design reviews for significant network initiatives.
* Mentor engineers and raise technical capability across the wider networking organisation.
* Lead complex technical decisions and incidents spanning networking, systems, storage, and AI/HPC workloads.

* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to engineers, operators, and senior stakeholders.

* Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly.

* Strong experience working with data and maintaining data quality

# KYC Analyst

**Are you a detail-oriented professional with strong judgement, a commitment to high compliance standards, and a passion for delivering excellent client service?**

Embark on a pivotal role as a KYC Analyst and play a key part in our client onboarding journey. You’ll help safeguard our operations while also acting as a trusted point of contact for clients—guiding them through Know Your Customer (KYC), Anti-Money Laundering (AML), and Source of Funds (SOF) requirements with clarity, efficiency, and professionalism.

---

**Who are We:**

Movera is a flourishing platform business that brings together ambitious home moving brands from across the sector. Built on the heritage and passion of experienced legal services businesses including ONP Solicitors and Cavendish Legal Group, brought together to transform the moving market for the better. Our vision is to create moving and remortgaging experiences to be celebrated – not tolerated.

**The Role**

Within our busy conveyancing environment, you’ll take ownership of verifying client identities, liaising directly with clients to assess source of funds, and carrying out proportionate risk assessments.

This is a high-volume, fast-paced role, where you’ll be working todefined targets and SLAs.You’ll need to balance speed with accuracy, ensuring regulatory checks are completed to a high standard while maintaining momentum in the client onboarding journey.

Alongside your compliance responsibilities, you’ll play an important role in delivering a positive client experience—supporting individuals through what can often be a complex and time-sensitive process. You’ll combine attention to detail with efficiency and empathy, ensuring clients feel informed, supported, and confident at every stage.

---

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conduct client due diligence (CDD) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) in line with the Money Laundering Regulations
* Perform KYC checks on individuals and corporate entities, using electronic verification tools and manual review where necessary.
* Analyse and assess source of funds/source of wealth information for conveyancing transactions.
* Act as a key point of contact for clients, guiding them through KYC requirements with clear, supportive, and professional communication.
* Liaise with clients by telephone and in writing to gather and clarify KYC documentation, ensuring they feel informed and supported throughout the process.
* Identify and escalate any high-risk clients or suspicious activity to the Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) or Deputy MLRO.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of client verification and due diligence checks.
* Liaise with fee earners and client onboarding teams to gather and clarify KYC documentation.
* Conduct periodic reviews and ongoing monitoring of existing clients.
* Keep up to date with regulatory and legislative changes in AML/KYC and conveyancing compliance.
* Assist with internal and external audits by providing relevant compliance documentation and support.
* Support the implementation and improvement of KYC procedures, controls, and training materials.
* Work in line with operational SLAs and Targets within the broader Conveyancing timelines

---

**Person Specification:**

* **Client Focus** – A genuine commitment to providing a high level of customer service, with the ability to support and reassure clients through regulatory processes.
* **Performance-Driven** – Comfortable working in a high-volume environment, with experience of meeting targets and working to SLAs.
* **Communication** – Strong written and verbal skills; able to explain complex compliance requirements in a clear, approachable, and client-friendly way.
* Proven ability to analyse and verify the source of funds, ensuring compliance with anti-money laundering regulations.
* Attention to Detail - high level of accuracy in reviewing documentation and conducting checks.
* Regulatory Knowledge - Understanding of UK AML and KYC regulations, including the Money Laundering Regulations 2017.
* Analytical Skills - Ability to assess risk and interpret complex information relating to property transactions.
* Organisation - Capable of managing a high-volume workload with competing priorities.
* Confidentiality - Demonstrates discretion and professionalism in handling sensitive client data.
* Teamwork - Works collaboratively with colleagues across compliance, legal, and operational teams.

This role is vital in ensuring that the firm meets its regulatory obligations while facilitating smooth and compliant client onboarding in a conveyancing context. The ideal candidate will be detail-oriented, proactive, and have a strong understanding of financial crime risks associated with property transactions.

---

**What we offer:**

We aim to reward your hard work generously. You’ll be greeted in our offices with great coffee, fruit and biscuits to keep you going, alongside all the benefits listed below, plus much more.

* 27 days holiday + your Birthday off!
* Hybrid working available after an initial full-time training period.
* Buy & Sell Holiday Scheme – flex your time off by up to 5 days per year
* Health Cash Plan to support everyday healthcare costs
* Additional annual leave based on length of service, starting after 1 year
* Free conveyancing legal fees
* Moving home days off
* Volunteering days
* Retailer discounts and frequent socials
* Refer a friend bonuses

Ensure the hardware information behind OQC’s quantum computers is accurate, controlled and fully traceable throughout the engineering lifecycle.

As a Configuration Engineer, you’ll own day-to-day configuration data, engineering Bills of Materials and hardware release records. Working within Engineering Operations and reporting to the Head of Design Engineering, you’ll sit at the intersection of Engineering, Operations and Supply Chain. You’ll manage the information that defines released hardware configurations, ensuring product structures, drawings, specifications and revisions remain complete, consistent and traceable.

You’ll work across Arena PLM, SolidWorks PDM, CAD data and downstream systems, resolving discrepancies and supporting Engineering Change Request and Engineering Change Order workflows. * Structure and maintain accurate multi-level engineering Bills of Materials, ensuring product structures reflect released engineering intent.
* Maintain hardware release records and configuration data across components, assemblies and product revisions.
* Facilitate Engineering Change Request and Engineering Change Order workflows, ensuring changes are properly recorded, progressed and traceable.
* Review technical release packages for completeness and configuration accuracy before drawings, specifications and engineering data are released.
* Administer Arena PLM and SolidWorks PDM workflows, including lifecycle states, routing, permissions and configuration data.

The Senior Manager Commercial and framework Partners is responsible for maximising revenue through strategic procurement frameworks and commercial partnerships. You will provide strategic procurement guidance, support complex commercial negotiations and act as a senior procurement and contractual adviser to the UK Growth team

* Build and manage senior relationships with major framework providers and procurement authorities.
* Develop joint engagement plans that increase visibility, generate pipeline opportunities, and maximise framework utilisation.
* Identify emerging frameworks and secure positions on strategically important procurement vehicles.
* Create sustainable opportunity channels for the Sales team through strategic partner engagement.

#### Lead Procurement-Led Growth

* Own the commercial strategy for procurement and framework opportunities across healthcare markets.
* Guide customers through compliant procurement routes and buying frameworks.
* Develop procurement guidance, commercial collateral, and supporting resources to simplify the customer purchasing journey.
* Collaborate closely with Sales, Bids, Finance, Legal, and Product teams to accelerate opportunity progression.

#### Influence Senior Procurement Stakeholders

* Develop trusted relationships with Procurement Directors, Heads of Procurement, Commercial Directors, and Category Managers.
* Engage stakeholders early to identify requirements, reduce procurement barriers, and shape successful routes to market.
* Act as Radar Healthcare's procurement and framework expert, both internally and externally.

#### Lead Commercial Negotiations

* Support and lead negotiations relating to customer contracts, framework call-offs, and commercial agreements.
* Partner with Legal, Finance, Information Security, and senior leadership to manage contractual discussions and risk.
* Balance customer requirements with commercial objectives while maintaining momentum in strategic opportunities.

#### Enable Internal Success

* Provide procurement expertise during bid reviews and strategic deal discussions.
* Deliver coaching and training to commercial teams on framework sales, procurement routes, and stakeholder engagement.
* Create playbooks, templates, and best-practice guidance that support scalable commercial growth.

### *Your journey so far...*

* Significant experience in public sector procurement, framework management, commercial management, or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of procurement frameworks, routes to market, and public sector purchasing processes.
* Proven success building relationships with senior procurement and commercial stakeholders.
* Experience leading complex commercial and contractual negotiations.
* Ability to translate procurement requirements into practical business solutions.
* Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Legal, Finance, and operational teams.

### *Even better if you...*

* Experience within HealthTech, healthcare software, or SaaS.
* Knowledge of NHS and wider public sector procurement frameworks.
* Experience with framework call-offs, competitive procurement processes, and enterprise-level opportunities.
* Understanding of healthcare procurement challenges and governance requirements.

## Company Description

For 35 years, we have been helping companies grow. It is a path that we know well. When Radius started its business in 1990, it was running a successful fuel SME in the North West of England. Today, we are a global business services company operating in 19 countries on five continents.

Our mission is to help businesses of all sizes adapt to market changes and take advantage of the opportunities that come with them.

We differentiate ourselves by our ability to provide SMBs with fleet and connectivity products and services in a single solution, as well as customised solutions for enterprise-level businesses.

## Job Description

**Job Title:** Executive Assistant

**Location:** Radius Campus HQ, 08:30am - 5pm, in office 5-days per week

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an Executive Assistant to join our Executive Operations team, supporting our Group CEO.

Reporting to the Head of Executive Operations, you will play a key part in the smooth running of the Group CEO’s office, supporting diary management, travel, meeting coordination and administration. You will work closely with, and under the guidance of, the Head of Executive Operations, who will set priorities and support you in the role.

This is an excellent opportunity for a Personal Assistant or Executive Assistant with two to four years’ experience who is ready to step into a high-profile role at the heart of a global business, with the mentoring and development to grow into a senior Executive Assistant position over time.

We will be happy to welcome you to our Campus HQ Crewe, with core working hours of Monday to Friday from 8.30 am to 5.00 pm. Given the profile of the office you will support, some flexibility to provide support outside core hours will occasionally be required.

**Your daily responsibilities will be...**

* Supporting the day-to-day management of the Group CEO’s diary under the guidance of the Head of Executive Operations, scheduling meetings, resolving clashes and keeping the diary accurate and up to date.
* Monitoring and triaging correspondence into the Group CEO’s office, drafting straightforward responses and escalating items to the Head of Executive Operations where appropriate.

* Maintaining accurate records, contact lists, distribution lists and filing for the Group CEO’s office.
* Handling confidential and sensitive information with absolute discretion and sound judgement.
* Building effective working relationships with colleagues and external contacts, always representing the Group CEO’s office professionally.
* Providing support to the Head of Executive Operations and the wider EA community as required, including occasional cover and ad hoc project work.

* Strong academics, with degree-level education and/or relevant professional qualifications.
* Excellent diary management and scheduling skills, with confident use of Microsoft Outlook and the wider Microsoft 365 suite.

# Global Head of Agentic Automation Capability

Apply Now

**Roboyo AI is a category shaper in Applied AI and Agentic Automation.**We help leading enterprises move from automation projects and AI experiments into governed, production-grade systems that execute real work across workflows, processes, products and services. 

Our heritage is in scaled enterprise automation; our future is Applied AI and Agentic Automation: autonomous agents, AI engineering squads, process orchestration, data and knowledge foundations, and human-in-the-loop governance embedded deeply into how our clients operate. 

We are not here to sell AI theatre. We are here to turn AI into working systems, measurable outcomes and repeatable transformation programs.

**About Roboyo**

Roboyo believes work should be worthy of humans. We help leading enterprises move from automation projects and AI pilots to governed, production-grade systems that execute real work across their processes, workflows and applications. 

Our heritage in scaled enterprise automation is our advantage: knowing how workflows and processes actually run, and how to rebuild them. Our future is Applied AI and Agentic Automation, which demands exactly that. We work in partnership with Anthropic, OpenAI and Microsoft Data and AI, at the frontier of what these systems can actually do. The combination of process depth and frontier access is why enterprises trust us to industrialise AI across core business functions. 

**About the Role**

As Global Head of Agentic Automation Capability at Roboyo, you will lead our largest capability and own the flagship offering that defines us in the market. 

You inherit a global automation capability with real scale: experienced practitioners, deep client relationships and a revenue base built over years of enterprise delivery. Your mandate is to carry that base forward and change what it sells. The process and workflow mastery already inside these teams is the hardest part of agentic to buy, and the reason enterprises pick us over a model provider or a systems integrator. Converting it, without breaking the business that funds the conversion, is the job. 

Working closely with market leadership, sales and our partners, you will own what Roboyo sells in agentic: the offering and its P&L, the IP and assets behind it, the pricing architecture and the risk we carry on outcome-based work, the platforms it builds on, our global partner relationships, and the capability to deliver it at scale. You will lead the highest stakes pre-sales personally and turn our strongest delivery into reusable IP. 

We are looking for an experienced leader with a deep client network who combines expertise in workflow and process with commercial and technical ownership. Someone who attracts top-tier talent to run agentic consulting engagements and deliver systems that reach production and stay accountable. 

The window for this is open now. Enterprises are moving from pilots to production, and very few firms hold frontier partnerships and deep process heritage at the same time. This is a chance to define a category rather than catch up to one. 

**Responsibilities** 

**The offering and its economics** 

* Hold global P&L accountability for the agentic capability, its revenue growth, delivery economics, pricing architecture and the risk envelope on outcome-based work.
* Own the agentic offer shelf and back it with what wins: offering materials, demos, reference architectures, assets, accelerators and pricing guidance.
* Act as gatekeeper for commercial and delivery governance on major agentic proposals, holding the line on margin, scope and deliverability before we commit.
* Protect the automation revenue that funds the pivot while converting it, so the base stays healthy as the mix shifts.

**Sales and go to market** 

* Lead pre-sales personally where the deal is largest, most complex or most novel.
* Own global partner and platform relationships across our frontier AI partnerships and our established automation vendors, including co-sell, joint positioning and our certification standing.
* Serve as an external ambassador for Roboyo, carrying our IP and point of view into the market through thought leadership, analyst conversations and published client stories.
* Work as one with market leadership and the other capability leads, so clients buy one Roboyo rather than a set of service lines.

**Engineering standard, methodology and IP** 

* Define the autonomy thresholds, evaluation standards and guardrails for what we are willing to put into production.
* Own the delivery methodology for agentic work, from discovery through production and into measured client value.
* Decide our platforms and tooling, and which assets get built.
* Convert our strongest delivery work into reusable IP, and market and technology shifts into propositions clients will buy.
* Turn advances in AI-assisted engineering into leverage inside our own delivery, so we build faster and at better economics than the market.

**People and capability** 

* Set and uphold the standard for who delivers this work, from hiring through development pathways and certification depth.
* Own the pathway that takes our automation community into agentic: cohorts, credentials, enablement and a practitioner community that carries the standard between regions.
* Own global demand and capacity planning for the capability, including how bench time is invested.
* Act as tollgate for key hires and promotions, and give the feedback that makes our careers framework real.
* Escalate the risks that matter to the executive early, with a recommendation attached.

**The First Six Months**

* Flagship offer, pricing and assets live in market, and sellers can sell them without you in the room.
* An automation community that knows what it is becoming: the pathway to agentic defined and communicated, a first cohort already delivering agentic work for clients, and a practitioner community live and seen as the go-to place for knowledge sharing, learning and best practice.
* Methodology defined and embedded with teams, so agentic work reaches production and its value is measured at client P&L level.
* Partner standing on track, with certification targets met and joint case studies published for each partnership that requires them.
* One proprietary asset or piece of IP for the offering in production, embedded into the sales motion and delivery.
* A baseline for agentic delivery economics established and reported, with a credible plan for where margin goes next.

**Requirements**

* 15+ years in automation and digital transformation, including a minimum of 5 years at Director or VP level leading globally distributed teams.
* Full P&L ownership of an automation or AI practice, with accountability for revenue, margin and pricing.
* A proven track record delivering enterprise-scale intelligent automation programmes end-to-end, from business case through implementation and adoption.
* Deep fluency in agentic AI, spanning multi-agent orchestration, production deployment, evaluation, observability, and the compliance posture regulated clients require.
* Credible engineering leadership: you have led teams building to modern SDLC, CI/CD and agile standards, and you hold your own with architects even if you are no longer hands-on.
* Working command of the automation and agentic platform landscape, spanning established vendors such as UiPath and Microsoft alongside emerging orchestration and agent tooling.
* Pre-sales leadership on large transformation deals, shaping value directly with customer CxOs.
* Established partner and alliance relationships, with a record of driving co-sell pipeline and joint go-to-market.
* Experience taking an existing practice through a technology transition, carrying a revenue base while changing what it sells.
* Experience building global practitioner capability and developing leaders who outlast your tenure.
* Business case fluency: you articulate value in the language of the client’s P&L rather than the technology.
* A degree in engineering, computer science or a related field; an MBA is a plus.

**The Person** 

* High energy and driven, focused on solutions rather than problems.
* Influences without relying on authority, across regions, functions and partners.
* Credible with C-level executives, on their side of the table and on ours.
* A strategic planner who works in milestones and dates, not intentions.
* A team player whose impact shows up in what other people become able to do.
* Leads any discussion with practical examples, not cool-sounding – but vague – concepts.

**Location and Travel**

* Global, full time. Base location flexible within our operating regions.
* Native or C2 proficiency in English.
