**Parental Leave**  
Our enhanced parental leave policy supports all new parents after three months of employment. Primary caregivers receive 16 weeks of full pay, followed by 50% pay for an additional 16 weeks. Secondary caregivers receive four weeks of full pay, plus an additional two weeks after three years of service.

We host regular team socials, from monthly in-office drinks to quarterly offsites, celebrating milestones and enjoying time together as a team.

* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to a range of stakeholders

**Office Coordinator (Front of House & Leadership Support)**

**Role summary**
A hands-on, highly organised and professional **office all rounder** to act as the day-to-day "go to" for a modern office of around 100 people. The role covers front-of-house reception, coordination of office facilities and meeting spaces, guest logistics, light diary/admin support to senior leaders and other administrative tasks as needed.

While the role holder will be primarily based at the office reception (front desk), they will have the flexibility to move around the office as needed to carry out day-to-day tasks, checks and support activity.

The role requires someone confident taking ownership, using initiative, and making sound day-to-day decisions to ensure the office operates smoothly and presents a professional environment at all times.

The position is **fully office based** and located in the heart of Romford. The post holder is expected to be **onsite Monday to Friday between 8.45am and 5.15pm**. This is a **7.5hour working day**, with a **1hour lunch break**, taken in line with business needs to ensure appropriate office cover.

**Initial focus - office move preparation**
Upon joining KGM, the initial focus of the role will be supporting the **Business Manager & Executive Assistant to the Managing Director** and the **Service Delivery Manager** to prepare the current office for an upcoming move to new premises within Romford in October 2026.

This will be a **hands-on role**, supporting practical readiness, coordination, and day-to-day organisation in the leadup to the transition. The role has been created **ahead of the office move** to allow the successful candidate to fully immerse themselves in the planning, preparation, and execution of the move - ensuring they are ready to **hit the ground running from day one** in the new office environment.

This initial phase will also be a key opportunity for the role holder to **get to know KGM and its people**, building strong working relationships and rapport across teams. Through day-to-day interaction, visibility in the office, and hands-on involvement in the move preparation, they will quickly establish themselves as a **trusted, professional and confident presence** - someone colleagues feel comfortable approaching and relying on.

**Key responsibilities**
Front of House / Reception

* Act as first point of contact for visitors, creating a confident, professional welcome and ensuring sign-in/badging processes are followed.
* Handle general enquiries, post/couriers and deliveries, using judgment and initiative to resolve issues where possible.

**Office facilities & day-to-day operations**

* Maintain office standards: kitchen, stationery, hygiene supplies and general consumables; place online orders and keep stock levels tidy and controlled.
* Work alongside the contracted office cleaner, who has responsibility for maintaining the overall cleanliness of the office and who visits twice a day. As the cleaner will not always be on site, the role holder will be comfortable carrying out occasional light spot cleaning as needed (e.g. if there is a spillage) to ensure the office always remains presentable.
* Log facility issues (e.g., heating/lighting/repairs), with the Howden Group CRES Support team.
* Issue, manage and maintain staff access passes, keeping records up to date and ensuring access is controlled appropriately.
* Manage staff locker access, including allocation, tracking and leaver resets. Hold and securely control the master locker key/pass, using it to provide access overrides in the event of lost keys or access issues, and maintaining appropriate records of use.
* Coordinate car park access for staff, including permits, access instructions and maintaining accurate logs.
* Support office set-up for new starters/movers (access basics, welcome/orientation support).
* Proactively identify issues or improvements in the office environment and take initiative to resolve them or elevate appropriately, rather than waiting for direction.

**Meeting rooms & hosting**

* Be comfortable carrying out daily **AV and tech checks** in all meeting rooms, including checking displays/screens are working and testing audio and cameras (training will be provided). Escalate more complex issues where required.
* Coordinate external guests: arrival instructions, hosting and catering/refreshments.
* Help drive consistent meeting room etiquette and smooth booking practices.

**Health & Safety (H&S)**

At the Würth Elektronik Group, we produce and sell electronic components such as printed circuit boards, electronic components, electromechanical elements and complete system assemblies. The Group is internationally active in various markets with three business divisions and around 7300 employees, a lot of team spirit and just as much passion. in Manchester

You connect technical understanding, partner relationships, and market requirements. Your goal is to position Würth Elektronik components in relevant reference designs and evaluation boards, support technical partners with strong application expertise, and contribute valuable market input to product development.

* **Build relationships:** Visit semiconductor partners regularly across the UK and Ireland and travel to Belgium, the Netherlands, and Scandinavia a few times per year.

* **Identify potential:** Gather product gap intelligence from partner interactions, assess market viability, and feed findings into our product development process.
* **Understand technology:** Carry out quarterly benchmarking of power supply boards using WE inductors and prepare structured reports. Depending on your profile, this may also include EMC, stability, or layout optimisation topics.
* **Work internationally:** Collaborate closely with colleagues in Germany and France as well as with global counterparts in the USA and Asia.

## Your convincing skills:

* **Basics:** Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a comparable field; Master’s degree is a plus.
* **Knowledge:** Background in or strong interest in power electronics and/or magnetics.
* **Passion:** Enjoy working in an international technical environment and turning application knowledge into concrete design-in success.
* **Willingness to travel:** Comfortable owning a large territory and travelling regularly within the region.
* **Communication:** Strong communicator and confident presenter in front of technical audiences. Very good English skills are required.
* **Strengths:** Autonomous, well-organized, structured, and confident in building strong technical partnerships.

* **Well prepared:** Comprehensive onboarding and close collaboration with experienced colleagues to get to know our products, processes, and interfaces in depth.
* **Perspective:** Opportunities for personal and professional development through feedback meetings, development programs, and individual training opportunities through the Akademie Würth.
* **Strong environment:** Work in a highly qualified and collaborative international team with close exchange across countries and functions.
* **Variety and flexibility:** Field-based work, independently schedulable partner appointments, and modern technical equipment.
* **Internationality:** Collaboration with colleagues and partners across countries and cultures in a global technical environment.

At Würth Elektronik eiSos, we live and love our extraordinary team spirit! We all pull together because we know that we can achieve more together. Together we create intelligent paths and solutions for the electrical industry. We always have this common goal in mind and yet we never lose sight of people on the way there.  
  
Become a part of Würth Elektronik eiSos and apply now!

### About Zego

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has.

AI takes the routine work off every team, from Finance to Product to Marketing, so people ship real code and launch custom dashboards in minutes. ### Purpose of the role

Zego Insurance Limited (ZIL) is the Group's regulated insurance carrier, based in Gibraltar and supervised by the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC). As Head of Finance, you are the ultimate owner of ZIL's financial health, accuracy and operational integrity. Because ZIL underwrites risk on its own balance sheet, the role demands deep, specialised expertise in insurance carrier accounting and technical reserves, not broker or agency finance.

This is a hands-on "player-coach" role. You'll run a lean finance function with one direct report while working in lockstep with the Actuarial team and Group Finance. You'll own the end-to-end financial accounting cycle, ensure strict adherence to Gibraltar and insurance regulatory standards, and design and enforce robust financial controls. As a GFSC-regulated person, you carry personal regulatory responsibility for the accuracy and timeliness of ZIL's financial reporting.

### What you will be doing

**Insurance balance sheet and financial accounting**

* Own the general ledger and the insurance balance sheet in NetSuite, ensuring accurate accounting for premiums, claims, commissions, reinsurance recoveries and profit-share arrangements.
* Lead and execute the month-end and year-end close, producing management accounts (P&L, balance sheet and cash flow) tailored to an insurance carrier, delivered to agreed Group and Board reporting deadlines.
* Prepare and submit annual statutory accounts under UK GAAP (FRS 102) and the applicable Gibraltar Companies Act requirements, and support regulatory returns to the GFSC.
* Ensure all balance sheet accounts, bank and fiduciary accounts, and intercompany balances (including MGA/ZIL positions) are rigorously reconciled every month, with the ledger reconciled to actuarial reserves before submission.

**Actuarial partnership and capital management**

* Act as the bridge between Finance and Actuarial: understand, validate and integrate technical reserve calculations (IBNR, UPR, URR and similar) into the ledgers, and reconcile management accounts to reserving figures.
* Support Solvency II reporting as applied in Gibraltar, including inputs to QRTs, the SFCR and the ORSA, and help monitor capital adequacy so the business maintains appropriate buffers.
* Partner with actuarial, underwriting and pricing teams to analyse loss ratios, combined ratios and profitability by product line, translating technical data into commercial insight for the Board.

**Financial controls, audit and risk**

* Design, implement and enforce robust financial controls and SOPs, particularly around payment approvals, counterparty exposure and credit terms, to prevent fraud and eliminate reconciliation discrepancies.
* Act as the primary point of contact for external auditors and the GFSC. Manage the annual audit end to end, from planning through to sign-off, closing findings and embedding fixes so issues do not recur.
* Ensure timely, accurate filing of corporate taxes and other regulatory financial submissions, working with Group tax where relevant.

**Lean team leadership and operations**

* Directly manage, mentor and develop one finance team member, staying in the detail of the ledger while owning the wider finance agenda.
* Oversee daily cash flow and liquidity, produce rolling cash flow forecasts, and support investment income accounting to ensure claims-paying ability and operational funding.
* Own the ZIL finance system stack (NetSuite), ensuring it integrates cleanly with policy administration and actuarial data to maintain absolute data integrity.

### What you will need to be successful

* A fully qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).
* A proven track record in insurance carrier (balance sheet) accounting. You understand the mechanics of insurance financials; broker or agency-only experience is not sufficient.
* Demonstrated experience working closely with actuaries, and a strong conceptual grasp of reserving, pricing and capital modelling.
* Familiarity with Solvency II reporting (QRT, SFCR, ORSA) and statutory accounts preparation; Gibraltar or comparable small-jurisdiction regulatory experience is an advantage.
* Demonstrable experience building, testing and enforcing internal financial controls.
* Experience managing and developing direct reports in a lean environment, and managing external audits end to end.
* The resilience to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment: you stay calm and effective when priorities shift, without ever letting quality or accuracy slip.
* Willingness and ability to hold a GFSC-approved regulated-person position for ZIL.
* You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

**Bonus points for**

* Big 4 audit experience with an insurance client portfolio.
* Hands-on experience with NetSuite in an insurance or MGA setting.

### What it's like to work at Zego

At Zego, we operate like a high-performing sports team. We come together as one, driven by ambition, backed by real support, and united by a shared mission to win.

Working here means having the backing, the coaching, and an inclusive community of Zegons across the UK and Europe who celebrate your wins and raise your game. It also means holding ourselves to high standards: moving with urgency, taking complete ownership, and embracing honest feedback that helps us continuously learn and evolve.

This is your opportunity for a career-defining experience, and one you will own.

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid- we would expect you to be in our Gibraltar office once a week and also be available for London HQ visits once a quarter. It is about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It is a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year...

* Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution

* Private medical insurance, for you and your family

**This role is available on a 12-months FTC basis, with potential for permanency.**

This is a significant part of Zoopla’s business, generating real revenue and shaping how professionals and their clients experience our brand.

This is a hands-on role with real scope to shape both what we build and how we build it. You’ll work across the full product lifecycle, from defining problems through to delivery and optimisation, designing experiences that are intuitive, useful and deliver real business impact. You won’t just respond to briefs; you’ll help define opportunity areas, connect work to broader product and business goals, and ensure what we build delivers measurable results.

This role suits someone who moves comfortably between feature and product-level craft and the wider systems and workflows they sit within, is comfortable when the buyer isn’t the user, and balances improving what exists today with shaping what comes next.

### Ownership and Impact

* Own design within your team from problem framing through to delivery and optimisation, taking responsibility for outcomes not just outputs
* Translate customer behaviour and insight into clear opportunities, prioritising work based on impact, effort and business value

### Designing across the commercial marketplace

* Design across the marketplace, from the workflows professionals rely on to the consumer-facing and advertising experiences that support those businesses
* Design intuitive, high-quality tools and platform experiences for frequent, high-volume use by expert users, accounting for the roles, permissions and operational complexity
* Connect workflows across the full customer lifecycle, from trial and onboarding through to adoption, expansion and renewal

### Data, Experimentation and Growth

* Define clear success metrics for your work through measurable outcomes
* Use data, research and behavioural insight to identify opportunities and inform decisions
* Design and iterate through experimentation, working with Product, Engineering and Data to test, learn and optimise journeys over time
* Continuously refine experiences based on performance, contributing to a culture of learning and optimisation

### Exploration and Craft

* Look beyond the current roadmap to identify new opportunities that drive customer and business value
* Rapidly explore and validate ideas through prototyping and testing
* Use modern tools and approaches, including AI-assisted design, to improve speed and quality of output
* Contribute to design systems and ways of working that improve quality, consistency and speed across a complex product suite

### Collaboration & Influence

* Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to align on goals and shape problems, not just solutions
* Influence prioritisation and decision-making by clearly articulating customer value, business impact and trade-offs
* Facilitate workshops and communicate ideas, rationale and outcomes clearly to stakeholders at different levels
* Act as a strong design voice within your team, raising the quality of thinking and execution

### What we’re looking for

Please include a portfolio (with ease of access) showing end-to-end work on complex, workflow-heavy problems.

* Proven experience designing B2B, SaaS, platform or marketplace products end-to-end.
* Experience designing complex, workflow-heavy interfaces, including multi-step processes, roles and permissions
* Strong product thinking, with the ability to connect design decisions to customer and business outcomes
* Fluent in qualitative and quantitative research methods, and comfortable working with experimentation and performance data
* Experience working directly with customers and with the internal teams who represent them
* Confident collaborating across disciplines, facilitating workshops and influencing decisions without authority
* Curious about emerging technologies (including AI) and how they can be applied to improve customer experience, decision-making and product capability
* Proficiency in design tools such as Figma or similar, and can adapt your approach to the needs of the project.

### The kind of designer who thrives here

* You think strategically and look beyond immediate tasks to identify opportunities and drive impact
* You take ownership from problem through to measurable outcome
* You’re comfortable when the buyer isn’t the user, and can design for both
* You understand how design contributes to business success, not just user experience
* You’re pragmatic about legacy, improving products incrementally while holding a clear long-term view
* You’re proactive, adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment

At Zoopla we embrace hybrid working but emphasise the importance of also spending time together. You’ll have the opportunity to work remotely (at home) for two days per week with Mondays and Thursdays as all-Zoopla days in the office together plus a third in-office day of your choosing.
